jobs.excerpt: About the RoleWe're looking for a Head of RevOps who sits at the intersection of go-to-market strategy, outbound channels and data/tools.
jobs.description:
About the Role

We're looking for a Head of RevOps who sits at the intersection of go-to-market strategy, outbound channels and data/tools. This is not a traditional sales ops or marketing ops role — you'll be the strategic backbone supporting our GTM engine, collaboratively building the processes, systems, signals, and segmentation that help us find the right customers faster and convert them more efficiently.

Reporting directly to the C-level, you'll own one of the most strategically important artifacts in the business: our Ideal Customer Profile. You'll define it, operationalize it, and keep it current — ensuring every team from Sales to Marketing to Product is working from the same north star.

What You'll Do

ICP Data and Win/Loss

  • Lead the definition and updating our Ideal Customer Profile (ICP) end-to-end — collaborate and bring leadership to the table as well as Sales, Marketing, and Account Management to constantly refine and look for new buying signals and focus our outbound
  • Build the initial ICP framework using firmographic, technographic, behavioral, and intent data, synthesized with insights from Sales, Professional Services, and Product
  • Create win/loss framework and reporting to feed into sales and GTM strategy
  • Run a recurring ICP review cadence (quarterly at minimum) to incorporate win/loss patterns, market shifts, and product evolution
  • Translate the ICP into actionable criteria that can be operationalized across the CRM, outbound sequences, paid campaigns, and content strategy
  • Create tiered ICP scoring models that allow teams to prioritize accounts and contacts dynamically
  • Maintain ICP documentation and communicate updates clearly across GTM teams so everyone is aligned and working from the same playbook

GTM Strategy & RevOps

  • Support a growing GTM org and own a stack that includes Salesforce and Hubspot.
  • Design and build end-to-end GTM workflows that reduce friction across the funnel — from first touch to closed-won
  • Automate outbound sequences, lead routing, enrichment pipelines, and handoff processes using tools like Clay, Apollo, HubSpot, Salesforce, Zapier, and n8n
  • Instrument and optimize the revenue tech stack to ensure clean data flow and maximum signal capture
  • Design internal tooling and integrations to solve GTM problems at scale
  • Work with technical support to design efficient and automated RevOps - Salesforce, Slack, automated customer data insights (you’re not hands on keyboard but you are the strategic direction)

Segmentation

  • Build dynamic segmentation models grounded in ICP criteria that power personalized outreach, prioritized pipelines, and targeted campaigns
  • Identify expansion signals, churn risk indicators, and whitespace opportunities within existing accounts
  • Help Sales focus their account strategy on existing accounts and GTM leadership focus C-level outbound on prospects that matter

What We're Looking For

Must-Haves

  • Experience in and deep knowledge of sales methodologies and GTM strategy, this is a strategic role not an operational role
  • Proven experience owning or leading ICP development — not just contributing to it
  • Hands-on experience with the modern GTM stack (CRM, enrichment tools, sequencing platforms, data warehouses)
  • Excellent communicator — you'll be translating complex data insights into clear direction for Sales, Marketing, and leadership
  • A bias toward building automation and agentic tools: if you do something twice, you should build a system for it
  • Experience with broader revenue tools including: Clay, Apollo, Clearbit, ZoomInfo, or similar enrichment/prospecting platforms, Salesforce and Hubspot for CRM/marketing
  • Prior experience at a B2B SaaS company in a high-growth environment
  • High comfort level with AI/LLM tooling for GTM use cases and in working with GTM teams to adopt automation and tooling (personalization, scoring, research automation)

Why This Role

You'll have a dotted line to the C-level and real ownership over the strategy and systems that drive revenue — not just maintaining them, but building them from the ground up. If you want a seat at the table where go-to-market decisions get made, this is it.

90 Day Success Plan:

  1. Win/loss framework
  2. ICP framework and buying signals/titles
  3. Outreach priority plan (named accounts and a way to prioritize and segment non-named accounts. Can be a hypothesis to start with and then refine)
  4. AI quick wins/tech roadmap - how can we be more efficient? What can we automate? (immediate and longer term backlog)
Base annual salary
$200,000—$230,000 USD

Our Guiding Principles

Our products are for nothing if their creators are not fulfilled in their work. We want our employees to flourish at Sureify. We do not fawn over status or titles, instead, we honor effort and intelligence. The best idea wins no matter which colleague proposed it. We do not shortcut our mission with overblown claims or false promises. Sticking to the truth is both a strategy and a principle for us.

Sureify is an Equal Opportunity Employer committed to diversity. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, national origin, citizenship, ancestry, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender perception or identity, age, disability, veteran or military status, or any other basis prohibited by law.

If you are a California resident, please be aware Sureify collects personal information from you during the application process, which may include your name, contact details, employment history, and educational background, in accordance with the California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA). We use this information solely to evaluate your candidacy for employment and may share it with internal hiring personnel as needed.

jobs.description:
About the Team

The Strategic Accounts team’s mission is to make Miro the nerve center for innovation inside the world’s largest companies. We partner with Fortune 500 and Global 2000 enterprises to help them accelerate product development, improve cross-functional alignment, and transform how teams move from strategy to execution.

This team sits at the center of Miro’s evolution from a collaboration product to an AI-powered innovation workspace. Our Strategic AEs operate as account CEOs, leading cross-functional account teams across Solution Engineering, Customer Success, Value Advisory, Professional Services, Product, Marketing, Partners, and executive leadership.

About the Role

Winning in Strategic Accounts is not about managing a territory or closing isolated deals. It is about building multi-year account strategies, identifying the customer’s most important business initiatives, and expanding Miro into mission-critical workflows across Product, Engineering, Design, IT, Operations, and transformation teams.

As a Strategic AE, you will own a focused portfolio of Miro’s largest enterprise customers. You will be expected to understand each account’s industry context, operating model, executive priorities, political landscape, renewal dynamics, and expansion potential. You will create pipeline through disciplined account-based execution, build executive alignment around measurable outcomes, and orchestrate Miro’s internal resources to turn strategic opportunities into durable enterprise partnerships.

What you’ll do

→Own a portfolio of named strategic accounts

Develop and execute deep account strategies across 3–10 global enterprise customers. Identify priority business initiatives, critical workflows, executive buyers, Champions, renewal moments, competitive risks, and multi-product expansion opportunities.

→Drive workflow-led expansion

Position Miro around high-value enterprise workflows such as product strategy, roadmapping, customer discovery, prototyping, planning, agile execution, technical diagramming, portfolio visibility, and innovation governance. Connect Miro’s platform to measurable customer outcomes, including faster product cycles, stronger alignment, improved productivity, and better execution across distributed teams.

→Build executive alignment and business cases

Engage senior leaders across Product, Engineering, Design, IT, Transformation, Finance, and the C-suite. Create compelling business cases that tie Miro to named customer initiatives, quantified pain, strategic priorities, and long-term value realization.

→Orchestrate complex account teams

Lead cross-functional PODs across Solution Engineering, Customer Success, Value Advisory, Professional Services, Product, Marketing, Partners, BDRs, and senior leadership. Align the team around clear account objectives, executive engagement plans, validation events, and expansion plays.

→Create and manage strategic pipeline

Maintain a disciplined account-based pipeline generation motion. Use executive outreach, customer workshops, field marketing, partner collaboration, BDR support, and renewal planning to stay multiple quarters ahead on pipeline coverage.

→Operate with rigorous sales discipline

Apply MEDDPICC and Command of the Message at an expert level. Build customer-validated problem statements, develop real Champions, secure Economic Buyer access, quantify business impact, and use mutual plans to drive complex opportunities forward.

→Shape how Miro wins in the enterprise

Bring field intelligence back to Product, Marketing, Customer Success, and leadership. Help refine Miro’s enterprise narrative, identify repeatable expansion patterns, mentor peers, and contribute to regional go-to-market strategy.

What you’ll need

  • 10+ years of SaaS sales experience, including significant experience selling to Fortune 500 / Global 2000 enterprises with 10,000+ employees.
  • Native level proficiency in Spanish and English
  • Proven success owning a small number of strategic named accounts and driving complex expansion motions across multiple business units, geographies, personas, and executive stakeholders.
  • Track record closing and expanding $250K–$1M+ enterprise opportunities, ideally including multi-product, multi-year, or transformation-oriented deals.
  • Strong ability to build executive relationships across Product, Engineering, Design, IT, Transformation, Finance, and C-level stakeholders.
  • Deep MEDDPICC and Command of the Message discipline, including strong qualification, Champion development, Economic Buyer engagement, quantified pain, decision-process management, and value-based selling.
  • Experience orchestrating cross-functional deal teams across SE, CS, Services, Value Advisory, Product, Marketing, Partners, BDRs, and executive sponsors.
  • Strong account planning discipline, with the ability to translate customer strategy into named initiatives, workflow opportunities, stakeholder maps, pipeline plans, and measurable expansion outcomes.
  • Comfort operating in complex, ambiguous enterprise environments where success requires persistence, business acumen, internal leadership, and the ability to create belief with both customers and internal teams.
  • AI fluency and curiosity, with a track record of leveraging AI tools to improve account research, stakeholder mapping, territory strategy, opportunity planning, customer insights, and overall sales productivity.

What's in it for you

We want you to feel supported, connected, and ready to grow. Our global benefits package generally includes equity, a wellbeing benefit, a WFH equipment allowance, and an annual Learning & Development stipend. Join a diverse team where you can do your best work. Full benefits may differ per location. If you would like to learn more about location-specific benefits, please refer to our Global Miro benefits board.

About Miro

Miro is a visual workspace for innovation that enables distributed teams of any size to build the next big thing. The platform's infinite canvas enables teams to lead engaging workshops and meetings, design products, brainstorm ideas, and more. Miro, co-headquartered in San Francisco and Amsterdam, serves more than 100M users and 250,000 companies collaborate in the Innovation Workspace. Miro was founded in 2011 and currently has more than 1,600 employees in 13 hubs around the world.

We are a team of dreamers. We look for individuals who dream big, work hard, and above all stay humble. Collaboration is at the heart of what we do and through our work together we hope to create a supportive, welcoming, and innovative environment. We strive to play as a team to win the world and create a better version of ourselves every day. If this sounds like something that excites you, we want to hear from you!

Check out more about life at Miro:

  • Youtube:
  • Blog:
  • Instagram:

At Miro, we strive to create and foster an environment of belonging and collaboration across cultural differences. Miro’s mission — Empower teams to create the next big thing — is how we think about our product, people, and culture. We believe that creating big things requires diverse and inclusive teams. Diversity invites all talent with different demography, identities and styles to step in, and inclusion invites them to step closer together. Every day, we are working to build a more diverse Miro, cultivate a sense of belonging for future and current Mironeers around the world, and foster an environment where everyone can collaborate and embrace differences.

jobs.description:
Veuillez noter que nous recherchons un·e artiste disponible pour une entrée en poste dès que possible, possédant une solide expertise en effets visuels photoréalistes.

L’artiste d’effets conçoit et réalise des simulations visuelles complexes, feu, fumée, fluides, destructions, effets abstraits, dans le respect des standards artistiques et techniques de Rodeo FX. Intégré.e au cœur du pipeline 3D, il.elle collabore étroitement avec la supervision FX, CG et les autres départements pour livrer des plans photoréalistes, dynamiques et techniquement solides. Sa créativité, sa rigueur et sa maîtrise des outils procéduraux permettent de traduire les intentions visuelles du projet avec efficacité.

Principales responsabilités :

Maîtrise de son métier

  • Produire des simulations complexes (fumée, feu, explosions, liquides, destructions, effets magiques ou abstraits) en respectant les directives artistiques et techniques.
  • Utiliser Houdini avec efficacité (Pyro, Flip, RBD, Vellum, SOPs) pour générer des effets optimisés et adaptables.
  • Maintenir un haut niveau d’autonomie dans la gestion des tâches FX confiées, du setup initial jusqu’au rendu final.
  • Assurer un contrôle qualité rigoureux de ses fichiers, caches et workfiles avant toute soumission.

Qualité créative

  • Proposer des solutions artistiques simples, efficaces et alignées avec la vision du projet.
  • Participer activement aux dailies et intégrer les rétroactions de manière constructive.
  • Adapter les effets aux besoins narratifs, au style visuel et au rythme de la scène.
  • Améliorer les prises de vue en apportant une valeur ajoutée créative aux simulations.

Qualité technique

  • Assurer l’optimisation des caches, la stabilité des setups et le respect des conventions techniques internes.
  • Identifier rapidement les problèmes techniques et y apporter des solutions fonctionnelles.
  • Collaborer avec l’équipe Pipeline pour intégrer ou tester de nouveaux outils selon les besoins du projet.
  • Vérifier la compatibilité des effets avec les autres départements (layout, lighting, comp).

Communication

  • Fournir des estimations réalistes, communiquer rapidement en cas de difficulté ou de risque de retard, et collaborer avec la production à l’ajustement des priorités si nécessaire.
  • Maintenir un échange fluide et respectueux avec la production, les leads et les artistes des autres disciplines.
  • Communiquer avec clarté sur les enjeux, délais, besoins ou limitations techniques.
  • Participer activement aux turnovers, briefings ou suivis d’avancement avec l’équipe projet.

Apprendre, transmettre et évoluer

  • Rester à l’affût des dernières pratiques, techniques et références en effets visuels.
  • Partager ses connaissances, outils ou techniques avec ses collègues.
  • Participer à la documentation ou à l’amélioration des méthodes de travail du département FX.
  • Accueillir les rétroactions avec ouverture dans une perspective de progression continue.
  • Expérience préalable en FX dans un studio VFX (10 ans minimum recommandé).
  • Excellente maîtrise de Houdini (Pyro, Flip, RBD, Vellum, SOPs).
  • Connaissances de base en compositing (Nuke) et en rendu (Arnold et Karma).
  • Connaissance en USD et Solaris.
  • Bon sens du mouvement, de la physique et du rythme visuel.
  • Rigueur, autonomie, souci du détail, esprit d’équipe.
  • Atout : connaissance de Flow Production Tracking, expérience en développement d’outils Houdini, scripts Python ou VEX.
  • Entrée en poste immédiate
  • Plusieurs opportunités disponibles
  • Contrats temporaires de durées variables

Diversité : Chez Rodeo FX, la diversité est une valeur fondamentale. Nous nous engageons à créer un environnement de travail inclusif et équitable, où les points de vue variés sont accueillis avec ouverture. Chaque membre de l’équipe apporte une perspective unique qui enrichit notre créativité, remet en question nos idées et nous aide à livrer un travail de qualité.

Rodeo FX peut utiliser des outils d’intelligence artificielle (IA) pour soutenir certaines étapes du processus de recrutement, comme la transcription des entrevues ou l’analyse préliminaire des candidatures. Ces outils peuvent être exploités par des fournisseurs tiers et les données peuvent être traitées à l’extérieur du Québec. Ces outils ne remplacent jamais la prise de décision humaine : toutes les décisions finales d’embauche sont prises par notre équipe de recrutement et nos gestionnaires.

Élue à plusieurs reprises l'un des meilleurs employeurs de Montréal et récipient du prix Mercuriades 2022 pour Employeur de l'année - Grande Entreprise, Rodeo FX est une compagnie créative haut de gamme de plus de 15 ans offrant des services d'effets visuels, d’animation et de publicité et d'expérience.

Nominée pour plusieurs Emmy® Awards pour son travail sur les séries Stranger Things saison 4, The Witcher saison 2 et The Lord of The Rings : The Rings of Power saison 1, l'entreprise indépendante lauréate d'un Oscar® compte près de 900 artistes qui travaillent dans des studios situés à Montréal, Québec, Toronto, Los Angeles et Paris.

Rodeo FX est un partenaire créatif des meilleurs conteurs du monde, notamment Netflix, HBO, Disney, Marvel, Amazon Studios, Warner Bros. et Sony, et a collaboré à des publicités pour YouTube, NBC et Apple. Ses projets actuels incluent Blue Beetle, Monarch : Legacy of Monsters, et Rebel Moon de Zack Snyder. Parmi les projets récemment sortis, citons John Wick : Chapter 4, Black Adam, The Little Mermaid de Disney et Love, Death and Robots Volume 3, pour lequel la société a remporté un prix VES 2023.

We are hiring a Business Development Manager to drive SmartDev's growth across European markets. You will sell our full service portfolio — AI-native ODC teams, project-based AI solutions, and managed engineering services — to SMBs, scale-ups, VC-backed startups, and mid-market enterprises across the UK and continental Europe.

This is a remote, individual-contributor hunter role. You will be SmartDev's commercial face in Europe — building pipeline through outbound campaigns, partner channels, and industry events; running consultative discovery; and closing deals. You will work closely with our EU-based Presales team and Vietnam-based delivery organization to scope, propose, and land engagements.

Strategic Business Development (60%)

  • Own the full sales cycle from prospecting through discovery, proposal, negotiation, and close across multiple service lines: ODC/dedicated teams, project-based AI solutions, and managed services.
  • Generate new business through outbound campaigns, networking, industry events (London Tech Week, Web Summit, VivaTech, AI & Big Data Expo), and in-person meetings with decision-makers in key EU cities.
  • Build and maintain a 12-month qualified pipeline of ODC and project-based opportunities with a clear path to revenue.
  • Lead consultative discovery: map client engineering and AI pain points — capacity gaps, talent shortages, tech debt, time-to-market pressure — to SmartDev's engagement models.
  • Structure and negotiate engagement models: AI-native dedicated teams, outcome-based projects, build-operate-transfer (BOT), staff augmentation, and managed application services (AMS).
  • Develop and activate partner channels: collaborate with independent AI consultants, technology resellers, startup accelerators, and SME digital innovation hubs to generate warm introductions and co-sell opportunities.

Solution Positioning & Technical Acumen (25%)

  • Articulate SmartDev's AI-native delivery value proposition: how our hybrid EU-Vietnam model combines European governance with high-velocity offshore engineering and embedded AI tooling.
  • Position SmartDev's competitive advantages vs. traditional consultancies (cost and speed), nearshore firms (AI maturity and scalability), and generic offshore vendors (European presence and senior technical leadership).
  • Collaborate with Presales and Solution Architects to scope technical feasibility, team composition, effort estimates, and pricing.
  • Identify cross-sell opportunities for NORA AI agents (enterprise search, workflow automation, support automation) within ODC and project accounts.
  • Use case studies, success metrics, and proof points (conversion uplift, process automation rates) to build credibility with prospects.

Sales Operations & Reporting (15%)

  • Maintain accurate pipeline reporting in CRM — deal stages, forecasts, activity logs, and conversion rates.
  • Lead proposal and RFP response development, ensuring accuracy, commercial viability, and quality.
  • Provide market intelligence on EU buyer behavior, competitive dynamics, and emerging verticals to inform go-to-market strategy.
  • Participate in tailored business workshops and technical demonstrations with decision-makers to accelerate deal closing.

KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS

  • Pipeline value generated (quarterly)
  • New logos and contracts closed per quarter
  • Revenue from new and existing accounts
  • Qualified meetings booked (jointly with Presales)
  • Average deal cycle time
  • Client retention and expansion rate

Must-Have

  • 5+ years in B2B sales or business development in the European market, with at least 2 years selling IT outsourcing, ODC, dedicated teams, staff augmentation, or software development services.
  • Proven track record of building pipeline and closing deals with SMBs, scale-ups, or mid-market enterprises in Europe.
  • Experience selling to both technical buyers (CTO, VP Engineering, Head of Product) and business buyers (CEO, COO, GM, Founder).
  • Strong understanding of the software development lifecycle, agile delivery, and common technology stacks.
  • Hunter mentality — comfortable with outbound prospecting, cold outreach, relationship mapping, and multi-stakeholder negotiations.
  • Excellent English communication (written and verbal). Additional European languages (German, French, Dutch, or Nordic languages) are a strong advantage.
  • Based in Europe with willingness to travel for client meetings, workshops, and industry events.

Nice-to-Have

  • Existing network of enterprise contacts, startup ecosystems, or partner channels in UK, DACH, Benelux, or Nordics.
  • Familiarity with AI/ML concepts and how AI tooling is transforming software delivery.
  • Experience working with offshore/nearshore delivery models and hybrid onshore-offshore team structures.
  • Knowledge of European data privacy and compliance requirements (GDPR) relevant to offshore engagements.
  • Experience with structured sales methodologies (MEDDIC, Challenger, SPIN).

The Person

  • Straight-talking, down-to-earth, and tenacious, with a genuine focus on delivery and building great relationships.
  • A first-class communicator who sells engineering outcomes, not headcount — using a consultative, value-based approach.
  • Comfortable operating independently in a remote role while staying closely aligned with teams across multiple time zones (EU + Vietnam).
  • A natural problem solver who assumes full accountability for their business targets.
  • Understands the value of transparency — ensures stakeholders have full visibility of pipeline and performance, with contingency plans for risks.
  • Entrepreneurial mindset — thrives in a growth-stage environment where you shape the playbook, not just follow it.

BENEFITS

  • International working environment with AI-driven strategic direction.
  • 20 days of annual leave – Hybrid working mode.
  • Premium healthcare package with PVI and comprehensive annual health check-ups
  • Competitive salary & 13th salary bonus
  • Lunch allowance to fuel your productivity.
  • Engaging company culture with fun activities
  • Global collaboration – Work with both Vietnamese and international colleagues.

SmartDev is an AI-powered software development company headquartered in Vietnam, part of the Verysell Group. We help global businesses deliver faster and build smarter — combining AI-driven development practices with deep expertise across fintech, healthcare, retail, and enterprise technology. Our team of engineers, architects, and AI specialists works across the full stack: from custom software and cloud solutions to generative AI, MLOps, and intelligent automation. At SmartDev, we believe that great architecture and AI-first thinking are a competitive advantage — and we build our teams accordingly.

The company is at a pivotal point in our journey: transitioning from a pure IT outsourcing provider to an AI-enabled solutions partner.

Role Overview:

The Senior Data Analyst will be responsible for transforming complex digital marketing data into actionable insights that fuel strategy across SEO, content, and social. This role is central to Greenpark’s data-first approach — ensuring every recommendation and decision is backed by robust analytics, forecasting, and measurable impact. A core responsibility includes leading Category Assessments, turning raw search data into structured insights for content and marketing strategies.

Key Responsibilities:

Data Management & Analytics

  • Consolidate and analyze multi-channel data (SEO, editorial, social, paid) into unified dashboards.
  • Develop forecasting models for traffic, lead generation, and campaign ROI.
  • Track performance across audits, category assessments, and monthly optimization cycles.

Category Assessment & Search Insights

  • Own the Category Assessment process, including:
    • Search Universe Sizing – quantify total search demand across categories and sub-categories.
    • Opportunity Mapping – identify priority keyword groups, trends, and white space opportunities.
    • Search Intent Analysis – break down user behaviors, phrasing, query patterns, and seasonality.
    • Cross-Platform Signals – integrate Google, YouTube, TikTok, and Instagram data for a true omnichannel view.
  • Translate findings into actionable opportunity maps that directly inform editorial, SEO, and social strategies.
  • Provide clear sizing and prioritization frameworks to guide investment decisions.

Insight Generation

  • Translate keyword, content, and social metrics into meaningful business insights.
  • Identify growth opportunities, risks, and optimization levers based on data trends.
  • Run competitor and market landscape analysis to benchmark performance.

Performance Reporting

  • Build and maintain reporting frameworks for internal teams and clients.
  • Deliver monthly performance reports with clear commentary on progress, gaps, and next steps.
  • Provide attribution analysis to demonstrate impact of SEO, content, and social investments.

Cross-Functional Support

  • Partner with SEO Managers, Editorial, and Social teams to embed insights into strategic roadmaps.
  • Ensure KPIs are aligned across Greenpark’s wider digital transformation initiatives.
  • Act as the point of truth for performance data integrity and consistency.

Skills & Qualifications

  • 4–6 years in digital analytics, ideally within marketing, SEO, or omnichannel contexts.
  • Proven experience in Category Assessments, keyword clustering, and opportunity mapping.
  • Proficiency with analytics & SEO tools (GA4, GSC, SEMrush, SimilarWeb, KeywordTool.io, Emplifi).
  • Strong statistical, data modeling, and storytelling skills.
  • Ability to simplify complex data into compelling, client-facing narratives.

Job Title: In-Home Physician Per Diem - Portsmouth

We’re building a world of health around every individual — shaping a more connected, convenient and compassionate health experience. At CVS Health®, you’ll be surrounded by passionate colleagues who care deeply, innovate with purpose, hold ourselves accountable and prioritize safety and quality in everything we do. Join us and be part of something bigger – helping to simplify health care one person, one family and one community at a time.

Do you have a passion for engaging with people and helping them on their journey to better health? Signify Health, part of CVS Health®, is seeking a Per Diem Physician to provide In-Home Health Evaluations, engaging with people in the comfort of their own homes and helping bridge gaps in care.

You’ll play a critical role in building trusted relationships to make people healthier, helping bring flexible, comprehensive and personalized health evaluations right to people’s front doors.

Job highlights
The visit, which lasts about 45 minutes, allows for time to connect one-on-one and answer health questions. It includes a medication and medical history review, a physical evaluation, and, if ordered by the person’s health plan, additional diagnostic tests (i.e., diabetic eye exams, spirometry, etc.). You’ll use an iPad and an intuitive clinical workflow for each evaluation and are not required to prescribe medicine, order lab tests or alter people’s current treatment regimen.

In this role, you will:

  • Bring your heart into every visit, joining a national network of purpose-driven clinicians dedicated to improving health outcomes

  • Be part of our efforts to visit millions of people nationwide with the goal of providing connections to the right care for people’s unique needs

  • Work with Signify Health as a clinician colleague, fulfilling the requirements of the specified role

  • Be flexible to travel locally and within licensed states, as needed

  • Conduct virtual visits as needed

  • Provide all Signify Health services as indicated including Diagnostic & Preventive Services products (i.e., spirometry, DEE, bone density screening, etc.)

A Note on Our Work Environment:
As an in-home clinician, your primary workplace is the private residence of health plan members. We are dedicated to meeting health plan members where they are, wherever they call home. These environments are diverse and may present a variety of conditions. Candidates must be able to comfortably and safely perform their duties in homes that may contain household pets, secondhand smoke and other potential airborne allergens or irritants.

Why Clinicians Enjoy Working with Signify Health
“Many of the people I see are shocked that a physician is coming to their home to visit with them one-on-one. When you sit down and have an unhurried conversation about their health, they are impressed, happy, and understand that their health plan and care team cares about them.” - M.L., MD

“The primary care physician gets a snapshot of a person in an office setting, but with Signify Health, we see things like the number of steps to enter their home, the state of disrepair those steps may be in, and the person’s ability to function comfortably and with ease in their own home. We can make referrals to the individual’s health plan, encourage the participation of their loved ones, and ensure their PCPs are aware of their health and overall quality of life.” - C.H., MD

Per diem employees qualify for:

  • Hourly base rate, plus additional incentive structure (i.e., per visit completed, other incentives may apply)

  • Malpractice insurance coverage (during Signify Health-related activities)

  • Supplies and other perks

Required & Preferred Qualifications (MDs and DOs)

  • Active, unrestricted license(s) in coverage area(s)

  • Multi-state licenses (preferred)

We move at the speed of AI. This is a high-ownership environment where engineers have direct impact on real-world systems operating at scale. You'll work on technology that is deployed in live customer environments and directly drives business outcomes.

This role offers the opportunity to solve complex integration challenges, build highly reliable systems, and shape how voice AI interacts with the physical world.

Overview

DecisionPoint seeks a Configuration Specialist to support enterprise Configuration Management (CM) operations for a large federal and DoD-aligned mission environment. This role ensures CMDB accuracy, updates configuration item (CI) records, manages asset relationships, supports CM audits, and maintains data integrity across baselines and operational environments.

The Configuration Specialist will work closely with the CM Lead, cybersecurity teams, DevSecOps engineers, system administrators, and the PMO to maintain accurate, up-to-date configuration data that supports compliance, audit readiness, and secure system operations.

This position is fully remote.

Duties & Responsibilities

The Configuration Specialist will:

  • Maintain CMDB accuracy by adding, updating, validating, and reconciling CI records.
  • Manage CI relationships, attributes, and lifecycle data to ensure traceability across systems.
  • Support CM audits, CI verification activities, and reconciliation tasks.
  • Identify and correct discrepancies, outdated data, or misaligned CI attributes.
  • Update baselines and document configuration changes in alignment with CM governance processes.
  • Coordinate with the CM Lead on configuration control workflows, documentation updates, and process improvements.
  • Work with cybersecurity and ISSM teams to ensure CI data aligns with RMF artifacts and control requirements.
  • Support inventory tracking, asset management, and system configuration validation efforts.
  • Assist release and DevSecOps teams with configuration-related information needed for deployments or pipeline activities.
  • Produce reports, CI summaries, and data extracts for technical teams and government stakeholders.
  • Maintain CM documentation, SOPs, diagrams, and CI attribute definitions.
  • Support efforts to reduce configuration drift and strengthen data integrity across environments.

Qualifications

  • Clearance Requirement

    Must hold an active Top Secret clearance, supported by a Tier 5 background investigation.

    Education (Required)

    Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Information Science, Computer Science, or a related field.

    Experience (Required)

    • Minimum 5 years of experience in configuration management, CMDB administration, IT asset management, or enterprise IT operations.
    • Experience updating CI records and maintaining CMDB accuracy.
    • Experience participating in CM audits, CI reconciliation, or baseline validation.
    • Experience supporting configuration governance, documentation, or asset tracking processes.
    • Experience collaborating with engineering, cybersecurity, or operations teams on CI-related tasks.

    Technical Knowledge (Required)

Rocket Money’s mission is to meaningfully improve the financial prosperity of millions of people. Rocket Money offers members a unique understanding of their finances and a suite of valuable services that save them time and money – ultimately giving them a leg up on their financial journey.

ABOUT THE TEAM 🤝

Rocket Money’s mission is to meaningfully improve the financial lives of millions of people. We help customers understand their money, reduce waste, stay on top of bills and subscriptions, and take action with more confidence.

The Rowan team is building the next generation of that work: a personal finance assistant that can notice what matters, reach out at the right moment, and help finish the job. Rowan’s goal is to be useful in the moments when people need help but do not have the time, energy, or context to do everything themselves.

Rowan’s already serving users with capabilities such as organizing someone’s finances, helping cancel or negotiate a bill, or surfacing the next action that gives a customer time, money, or peace of mind back.

ABOUT THE ROLE

As the Team Leader, Engineering for Rowan, you will lead the engineering team behind one of Rocket Money’s most ambitious product bets: building an agentic personal finance assistant that works over text message and, over time, potentially other surfaces too. This role owns the engineering craft, execution, and growth of the engineers on Rowan.

This is a role for an engineering leader who is excited by and experienced in AI as an execution layer, not just a conversation layer. Rowan’s promise is not “can it answer the question?” The promise is “can it safely, accurately, and verifiably solve the problem?” That means the work sits at the intersection of LLM-powered conversation, deterministic execution systems, human-in-the-loop operations, money movement constraints, trust and safety, and consumer-grade product craft.

You will set technical direction for the engineering team in service of the Rowan strategy, partner with other functional leaders on Rowan’s roadmap, grow senior engineers, and stay close enough to the product and systems to know what is actually working. You will help the team decide when a task should be handled by AI, by programmatic behavior, by a human, or by a hybrid workflow. You will also help create the operating system for how Rowan’s engineers builds: how we evaluate quality, recover from mistakes, earn customer trust, and turn ambiguous AI capabilities into dependable product experiences.

This is a good fit for someone who likes hard, slightly messy problems; who can move with urgency without turning urgency into panic; and who believes the less glamorous parts of agentic products (orchestration, approvals, evals, observability, operational fallbacks, and recovery paths) are not overhead. They are the product.

IN THIS ROLE, YOU'LL:

  • Lead, develop, and grow the Rowan engineering team, setting a high bar for technical judgment, product quality, customer trust, and steady execution.
  • Partner with product leadership to translate Rowan’s strategy (be the agent that finishes the job) into engineering plans and shipped capabilities that create measurable customer value.
  • Stay close to the full Rowan experience: conversational interfaces, orchestration, memory, app surfaces, detection systems, operational rails, human escalation paths, and the safety models required to act on someone’s finances.
  • Help the team build agentic capabilities that do consistent, correct and reliable work end-to-end.
  • Drive projects to a conclusion by making decisions, clearing blockers, aligning stakeholders, and helping the team consistently ship high-quality work customers can feel.
  • Build the systems and habits that make AI work dependable: eval frameworks, observability, approvals, fallbacks, recovery paths, human-in-the-loop workflows, and clear ownership.

L’entreprise propose des solutions complètes de bout en bout pour la protection des habitations et des entreprises, quelle que soit leur taille. À ce jour, le portefeuille de produits Ajax comprend 280 dispositifs couvrant la protection anti-intrusion, la vidéosurveillance, la sécurité incendie et la protection des personnes, ainsi que le confort et l’automatisation. Ajax Systems emploie aujourd’hui plus de 5 000 collaborateurs.
Nous développons des équipes locales, convaincus que les experts sur le terrain sont les mieux placés pour comprendre les spécificités de chaque marché. L’équipe Global Business Development est composée de profils partageant les ambitions élevées et la vision de croissance d’Ajax Systems.

jobs.description:
Overview

DecisionPoint seeks a System Architect to design and oversee enterprise application, mobile application, website, and tool architectures within AWS GovCloud in support of a large federal and DoD-aligned IT mission environment. This role develops scalable, secure, and maintainable architectures that align with mission requirements, cloud best practices, and DoD cybersecurity standards.

The System Architect collaborates closely with developers, cloud engineers, cybersecurity teams, and product leadership to define technical direction, validate designs, guide implementation, and ensure alignment with long-term modernization goals.

This position is fully remote.

Duties & Responsibilities

The System Architect will:

  • Architect enterprise applications, mobile apps, websites, and backend systems deployed within AWS GovCloud.
  • Define system architecture blueprints, integration patterns, data flows, and service interaction models.
  • Lead cloud architecture decisions including VPC configurations, security boundaries, and cloud-native service usage.
  • Provide technical oversight for development teams to ensure architectural compliance.
  • Design secure API integrations, identity and access flows, and cross-system data exchanges.
  • Ensure architectures meet performance, scalability, availability, and reliability requirements.
  • Develop migration paths, modernization strategies, and technical roadmaps for legacy systems.
  • Conduct design reviews, security evaluations, and architectural assessments.
  • Collaborate with cybersecurity teams to ensure alignment with DoD security controls and hardening requirements.
  • Work with database and DevSecOps teams on service orchestration, automation, CI/CD pipelines, and deployment patterns.
  • Produce detailed architectural artifacts such as diagrams, specifications, patterns, and system documentation.
  • Troubleshoot complex architectural issues and guide resolution strategies.

Qualifications

Clearance Requirement

Must hold an active Secret clearance, supported by a Tier 3 background investigation.

Education (Required)

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, or a related technical field.

Experience (Required)

  • Minimum 8 years of experience in system architecture, enterprise application design, or software engineering.
  • Experience architecting cloud-based applications using AWS or similar platforms.
  • Experience supporting enterprise or federal application ecosystems.
  • Experience designing APIs, integrations, data flows, and system communication patterns.
  • Experience performing architectural reviews, risk assessments, and modernization planning.

Technical Knowledge (Required)

  • Strong understanding of AWS GovCloud architecture, cloud networking, IAM, security patterns, and cloud services.
  • Knowledge of enterprise application architecture including microservices, APIs, and web application frameworks.
  • Familiarity with mobile application architectures and backend integration strategies.
  • Experience with secure coding principles and DoD cybersecurity requirements.
  • Understanding of CI/CD, DevSecOps practices, and automated deployment pipelines.

Technical Knowledge (Preferred)

  • Experience with serverless architectures and container orchestration.
  • Familiarity with modern frontend frameworks and mobile app development stacks.
  • Experience designing architectures for IL5 or other high-security environments.

Certifications

Required:

  • CompTIA Security+

Preferred:

  • AWS Solutions Architect (Associate or Professional)
  • CISSP or CCSP
  • ITIL v4 Foundation

Skills

  • Strong architectural design and systems thinking capabilities.
  • Excellent communication skills for engaging with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Ability to produce clear technical documentation and diagrams.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
  • Ability to guide development teams and enforce architectural standards.

jobs.description:
Position Overview

The Chief Sustainability Officer (CSO) is responsible for leading the organization's environmental, social, and governance (ESG) strategy and sustainability initiatives. The CSO drives the integration of sustainable business practices into corporate strategy, operations, risk management, and stakeholder engagement. This role ensures the organization meets regulatory requirements, sustainability goals, and long-term ESG commitments while enhancing corporate reputation and business resilience.

Key Responsibilities

ESG & Sustainability Strategy

  • Develop and execute the organization's ESG and sustainability strategy aligned with corporate objectives.
  • Establish sustainability goals, targets, and long-term roadmaps.
  • Integrate ESG principles into business operations, investments, and decision-making processes.

Environmental Sustainability Initiatives

  • Lead initiatives focused on carbon reduction, energy efficiency, waste management, and climate resilience.
  • Develop strategies to reduce environmental impact and support net-zero objectives.
  • Monitor environmental performance metrics and sustainability benchmarks.

Social Impact & Corporate Responsibility

  • Drive diversity, equity, inclusion (DEI), employee well-being, and community engagement initiatives.
  • Oversee corporate social responsibility (CSR) programs and social impact strategies.
  • Promote ethical business practices and stakeholder trust.

Governance & Compliance

  • Ensure compliance with ESG-related regulations, reporting standards, and frameworks.
  • Establish governance policies and sustainability reporting structures.
  • Collaborate with legal, risk, compliance, and audit teams on ESG governance.

ESG Reporting & Analytics

  • Oversee ESG disclosures, sustainability reporting, and impact measurement.
  • Ensure alignment with recognized frameworks such as GRI, SASB, TCFD, and ISSB where applicable.
  • Develop dashboards and KPIs to measure ESG performance and progress.

Stakeholder & Investor Engagement

  • Engage with investors, regulators, clients, and external stakeholders on sustainability matters.
  • Communicate ESG initiatives, progress, and impact transparently.
  • Represent the organization in sustainability forums and industry discussions.

Sustainable Business Transformation

  • Collaborate with business units to embed sustainability into operations, products, and services.
  • Support sustainable finance, green initiatives, and responsible investment strategies.
  • Identify opportunities for innovation and sustainable growth.

Risk Management & Resilience

  • Assess environmental and social risks impacting business operations and investments.
  • Develop climate risk and sustainability risk management frameworks.
  • Support enterprise resilience and long-term sustainability planning.

Leadership & Culture Development

  • Promote a sustainability-focused culture across the organization.
  • Lead and mentor ESG, sustainability, and CSR teams.
  • Drive employee awareness and engagement in sustainability initiatives.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Sustainability, Environmental Science, Business Administration, Finance, or related field; Master's degree preferred.
  • 12–15+ years of experience in sustainability, ESG, corporate responsibility, or related leadership roles.
  • Strong understanding of ESG frameworks, sustainability reporting, and regulatory requirements.
  • Proven track record of implementing enterprise-wide sustainability initiatives.

Key Skills & Competencies

  • Strong strategic and sustainability leadership capabilities.
  • Expertise in ESG frameworks and sustainability reporting.
  • Excellent stakeholder engagement and communication skills.
  • Analytical and risk assessment abilities.
  • Change management and cross-functional collaboration skills.

Performance Metrics

  • Achievement of ESG and sustainability targets.
  • Reduction in environmental impact and carbon footprint.
  • ESG ratings and reporting compliance.
  • Stakeholder and investor engagement outcomes.
  • Success of sustainability and CSR initiatives.

jobs.description:
Overview

DecisionPoint seeks a Digital Experience Architect (Senior) to translate experience strategy into scalable, accessible, and secure digital platform solutions supporting Military Community and Family Policy (MC&FP) initiatives under the MODES III contract. This role supports Task 2 Outreach and Engagement and works in close partnership with Task 3 technical architects and development teams to ensure experience strategies are technically feasible and operationally sustainable.

The Digital Experience Architect ensures experiences are accessible, scalable, secure by design, and aligned with MC&FP enterprise architecture and governance requirements.

This position is fully remote.

Duties & Responsibilities

The Digital Experience Architect (Senior) will:

  • Translate experience strategy and service design into platform, UX, and system requirements.
  • Partner with Task 3 architects, developers, and engineers to ensure technical feasibility.
  • Define digital experience architecture patterns and design standards.
  • Ensure digital experiences are accessible, scalable, and secure by design.
  • Support integration of UX and experience requirements into system and platform designs.
  • Collaborate with experience strategists, UX analysts, and content strategists.
  • Review and guide implementation to ensure fidelity to experience and architecture standards.
  • Support development of experience architecture documentation and design artifacts.
  • Identify experience related technical risks and mitigation strategies.
  • Support platform governance, design reviews, and architectural decision making.
  • Ensure compliance with accessibility, security, and enterprise standards.
  • Support continuous improvement of digital experience architecture practices.

Qualifications

Clearance Requirement

Candidate must possess a Tier 2 Moderate Risk Public Trust from any federal agency.

Education (Required)

Bachelor’s degree in Graphic Design, Interaction Design, Human Computer Interaction, Digital Media, Visual Communications, or a related field.

Experience (Required)

  • Minimum of 10 years of experience designing and architecting digital user experiences.
  • Experience translating experience strategy into technical and system requirements.
  • Experience partnering with developers and architects on complex digital platforms.
  • Experience supporting federal or public-sector digital systems preferred.

Technical Knowledge

Required:

  • Expertise in digital experience architecture and design systems.
  • Strong understanding of accessibility standards and inclusive design.
  • Knowledge of scalable and secure digital platform design.
  • Ability to translate UX requirements into technical specifications.

Preferred:

  • Experience supporting cloud based or enterprise digital platforms.
  • Familiarity with cybersecurity and privacy by design principles.
  • Experience working in Agile or iterative delivery environments.

Certifications

Required:

  • None

Preferred:

  • Certifications in UX design, accessibility, or digital architecture

Skills

  • Strong systems and design thinking skills.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication abilities.
  • Ability to bridge experience strategy and technical implementation.
  • Strong collaboration skills across design and engineering teams.
  • Attention to detail and design quality.
  • Ability to manage complex design ecosystems at scale.

It is the policy of DecisionPoint Corporation to provide equal employment opportunity in accordance with all applicable Equal Employment Opportunity/Affirmative Action laws, directives and regulations to all employees and qualified applicants without regard to race, ethnicity, color, religion, national origin, sex, age, disability status, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity, genetic information, protected veteran status, or any other protected status under Federal, State or Local laws.
  • Pay Transparency Policy: In accordance with Presidential Executive Order 13665, DecisionPoint Corporation will not discharge or in any other manner discriminate against employees or applicants because they have inquired about, discussed, or disclosed their own pay or the pay of another employee or applicant. However, employees who have access to the compensation information of other employees or applicants as a part of their essential job functions cannot disclose the pay of other employees or applicants to individuals who do not otherwise have access to compensation information, unless the disclosure is (a) in response to a formal complaint or charge, (b) in furtherance of an investigation, proceeding, hearing, or action, including an investigation conducted by the employer, or (c) consistent with the contractor's legal duty to furnish information.

Title: Sr. IT Security Analyst

Reports To: Director, IT Security Operations

Location: Pittsburgh, PA

American Eagle is a youth culture brand grounded in denim. Our purpose extends beyond making the best jeans–we embrace self expression, culture, optimism and connection. Through the brand platform Live Your Life, we empower our community to be who they want to be all while wearing the clothes that make them most confident.

Get to Know the Role:

Our Senior IT Security Analyst, within the Security Operations group, ensures proper configuration standards are met and sustained in compliance with security policy, procedures, standards, and industry requirements/best practices.

You will have the opportunity to implement and maintain cybersecurity controls including endpoint detection and response, identity protection, data loss prevention, security automation, application security testing, next generation firewalls, container security and automated compliance tools. Additionally, you will get to perform cybersecurity monitoring of American Eagle Outfitter’s cloud environments ensuring proper monitoring coverage that correlates with internal security operations and processes. If you want to focus on building secure solutions in a dynamic retail environment and are passionate about using your analytical skills to solve meaningful problems, AEO has a phenomenal opportunity for you.

What You’ll Do:

  • Configure, implement, monitor and support cybersecurity systems and controls supporting.
  • Configure security tools for logging /monitoring, and growing coverage of existing tools.
  • Make recommendations to management on enhancements to existing and new security software or related tools.
  • Assist in evaluating, planning and implementation of new/existing security applications/tools that integrate with current toolsets.
  • Help implement and maintain next-generation enterprise protection tools malware detection technologies.
  • Ensure security standard methodologies are identified and integrated into all facets of projects including network, system designs/configuration, and implementations.
  • Identify and recommend potential areas where existing data security policies and procedures require change, or where a supplement is required to mitigate key security risks.
  • Partner with various business units to enhance security policies/procedures.
  • Create and maintain data security documentation, policies, and procedures.
  • Configure, implement, monitor, and support network security software/systems that will help ensure compliance with CSA Cloud Controls Matrix in cloud environment.
  • Responsible for providing support during off hours for security.
  • All other duties as assigned.

What You Bring:

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent work experience required.
  • Five years of enterprise cloud (IaaS, PaaS, SaaS) experience, IT cloud security experience preferred.
  • Experience with Endpoint Detection and Response and Identity Protection.
  • Experience with data loss prevention tools including implementations for endpoint and cloud environments.
  • Experience with deception technologies including design, implementation and management.
  • Experience with cloud security posture management (CSPM) and cloud workload protection (CWP) tools.
  • Experience with Google Cloud Org Policies and/or Azure Policy and/or AWS Service Control Policies.
  • Deep knowledge regarding clouding networking, such as routing, traffic filtering (firewalls), load balancing, etc… for GCP VPCs and/or Azure VNETs and/or AWS VPCs.
  • Experience with container security including actual container workloads and Kubernetes engine.
  • Experience working IaC, such as Terraform and/or Azure Resource Manager templates and/or AWS CloudFormation Stacks.
  • Experience in hardening Google Workspace tenants.
  • Experience with Microsoft Active Directory, Azure AD and other cloud identity technologies.
  • Strong ability to critical think and solve problems.
  • Experience with threat detection and incident response in cloud and on premise environments.
  • Advise stakeholders and translate business requirements into secure, scalable, and reliable cloud solutions.
  • Complete security reviews and assessments with developers, operations, and infrastructure teams.
  • Partner with system engineering / DevOps to assess and reduce cloud security risks.
  • Assist with documentation of organizational security standards, processes, and governance model.
  • Knowledge of host hardening, auditing, logging, monitoring, network security, and anomaly detections.
  • Understanding of industry trends for cybersecurity risk & threat intelligence, and governance.
  • Assist with implementation and improvements of Cloud Security Operations capabilities within existing organizational support structure.
  • Assist with configuration of sending cloud logs to SIEM tool and creating rules for alerting on suspicious events.

Nice to Have:

  • Proficiency in ML frameworks, data analytics, and automation scripting.
  • Ability to interpret AI findings and conduct proactive threat hunting.
  • Understanding of AI risk frameworks (e.g., NIST AI RMF, ISO 42001).
  • Specialized in defending against AI-powered threats, such as deepfakes and advanced phishing.
  • Familiarity with Next Generation SIEM platforms.
  • Application Security Testing tools including static, dynamic, interactive and software composition analysis.
  • IT Security certifications, such as CISSP, GIAC, etc. are preferred.
  • Direct hands-on experience designing and implementing security with Google Cloud Platform and/or Microsoft Azure and/or AWS for both IaaS and PaaS offerings.
  • Cloud certifications, such as CCSP, AWS CSA, Google Cloud Professional, Microsoft’s Azure Solutions Architect is preferred.
  • Experience with DevOps and CI/CD tooling.
  • Experience in hardening Microsoft Office 365 tenants.
  • Knowledgeable with CSA CCM security framework and CIS Benchmarks for Cloud.

jobs.excerpt: Position SummaryThis role is not eligible for immigration sponsorship Samsung Electronics America, Inc.
jobs.description:
Position Summary

This role is not eligible for immigration sponsorship


Samsung Electronics America, Inc. (SEA), the U.S. Sales and Marketing subsidiary, is a leader in mobile technologies, consumer electronics, home appliances, enterprise solutions and networks systems. For more than four decades, Samsung has driven innovation, economic growth and workforce opportunity across the United States—investing over $100 billion and employing more than 20,000 people nationwide. By integrating our large portfolio of products, services and AI technology, we’re creating smarter, sustainable and more connected experiences that empower people to live better. SEA is a wholly owned subsidiary of Samsung Electronics Co., Ltd.
To learn more, visit Samsung.com. For the latest news, visit news.samsung.com/us.

Role and Responsibilities

The Builder Channel Regional Sales Director oversees and provides leadership for a multi-state regional market area, creating the sales plan for Samsung and Dacor brands executed through Builder Distribution. The role manages a team of 6 remote Sales Managers and develops the strategy for all builder trade customers across single-family (SF) and multi-family (MF) relationships, This director owns full P&L accountability for combined revenue across an 8-state territory — Florida, Georgia, North Carolina, South Carolina, Alabama, Tennessee, Mississippi, and Arkansas — and serves as the senior Samsung and Dacor brand representative to distributor principals, national and regional builders, multi-family developers, and architectural/design firms throughout the Southeast. The role requires a demonstrated strategic thinker who can translate organizational objectives into practical regional action plans while fostering a collaborative and inclusive team environment.

Position Objective

Revenue & Business Performance

  • Accountable for achieving all sales revenue goals for both Samsung and Dacor builder sales for the Southeast region.
  • Drive quote generation, pipeline development, and win-rate improvement across all segments: single-family (SF), multi-family (MF), MRO, hospitality, and remodeling.
  • Develop and execute the regional business plan, including annual and quarterly sales forecasts, account prioritization, and segment-level go-to-market strategies.
  • Keep abreast of competition, competitive issues, products, and market trends across the Builder channel; leverage strong national and regional market awareness to develop new strategies and refine competitive positioning to maximize Samsung and Dacor's competitive advantage.
  • Manage competitive displacement strategies to grow Samsung and Dacor share against key competitors in the Southeast new construction and remodeling markets.
  • Set measurable, specific, and compatible goals aligned with organizational objectives and values; prepare written presentations and reports for business reviews, sales presentations, trade shows, and internal executive reviews as needed.
  • Attend and participate in sales meetings, product seminars, national trade shows, and industry conferences to maintain market awareness and represent the Samsung and Dacor brands.

Team Leadership & Talent Development

  • Lead, coach, and develop a team of 6 remote Sales Managers across an 8-state territory, establishing clear KPIs, performance expectations, and individual development plans.
  • Drive a high-performance, accountability-driven team culture with emphasis on skill development, field coaching, and career progression; demonstrated ability to coach and elevate others analytically and strategically.
  • Own full-cycle talent management: recruiting, onboarding, performance reviews, succession planning, and performance improvement processes where required.
  • Develop and execute sales training materials and programs to build team capability across product knowledge, competitive positioning, negotiation, and customer engagement.
  • Foster a collaborative, inclusive team environment that shares best practices, elevates individual contributors, and builds organizational bench strength.
  • Responsible for personal development of direct reports and all recruiting for new or open positions within the region.

Distribution Strategy & Relationship Management

  • Create and manage the regional distribution strategy across distributor accounts — including independent Builder Distributors and Retail BDs,— ensuring all programs are implemented consistently.
  • Own senior-level relationship management with distributor principals and ownership groups, serving as the executive point of contact for strategic accounts in the Southeast.
  • Negotiate and manage annual distribution agreements, programming, and co-op marketing initiatives that drive sell-through and brand activation for both Samsung and Dacor.
  • Ensure Samsung and Dacor branded showrooms are properly resourced, trained, and executing display standards across the region.
  • Manage assigned MDF and Display budget to develop showroom and project business; analyze ROI of MDF investments to maximize market share impact.

Builder & Developer Strategy

  • Create the SF/MF builder strategy for the region, directing negotiations of contracts and programming; develop in-region SF national relationships based in the region.
  • Cultivate and maintain relationships with national and regional production builders at VP/Director-level purchasing and construction contacts, with particular focus on large key account planning and development.
  • Build influence with architectural and design firms — including NAHB, NKBA, and ASID-affiliated professionals — to ensure Samsung and Dacor are specified at the design stage of key projects.
  • Develop and execute multi-family developer relationships for large-scale MF appliance specifications; own executive-level relationships with major regional MF developers.
  • Be the voice of the customer — communicate direct builder and developer needs and requirements to internal teams to guide product development, process improvements, and go-to-market planning.
  • Identify and define new processes and systems needed to address the unique requirements of the SF and MF builder channel segments.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Work cross-functionally with SCM, BOC, Credit, and Product Management to achieve regional sales plans and objectives; support the Sr. Director with market intelligence, product input, and S&OP development.
  • Work directly with Product Marketing and Supply Chain Management teams for immediate and future product needs, forecasting, and product development opportunities.
  • Support the One Samsung initiative by creating synergies within the entire Builder channel — both direct and indirect — coordinating with peer directors and the Sr. Director to ensure channel alignment and minimize conflict.
  • Provide market intelligence, competitive insights, and voice-of-customer input to the Sr. Director and Product Marketing teams to inform product roadmap and planning.
  • Plan and coordinate with key internal groups including HA Business Management, HA Finance, HA Business Planning, Consumer Business Division Marketing and Communications, Shared Services, and the Customer Development Organization.
  • Collaborate with other Regional Directors on special projects as directed by the Sr. Director or VP of Builder Sales.
  • Partner with HR on talent strategies, workforce planning, compensation planning, and organizational changes within the region.
  • Partner with Demand Generation and Sales Operations on promotional planning, trade event presence, and regional market activations.

Skills and Qualifications

Minimum Qualifications:

Minimum 12 years of progressive sales leadership experience (with a Bachelor's degree) in the builder channel, home appliances, or a directly related building products industry — ideally including single-family and multi-family new construction. Minimum 5 years of direct people management experience leading remote, multi-state sales organizations. Demonstrated track record within a distribution or builder trade channel environment. Deep expertise in the distributor ecosystems, builder trade channels, and large key account management planning that serve the SF and MF construction markets. Experience with new process definition, documentation, and business case justification for operational or system development needs within a large, matrixed corporation.

Minimum Bachelor's Degree required. Master's Degree / MBA preferred (with 10 years' experience). PhD accepted with 7 years' experience. History of ongoing professional skill development and learning.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience selling or managing sales for a major home appliance brand (Samsung, LG, GE Appliances, Whirlpool, BSH, Electrolux, or equivalent) in a builder or trade channel capacity.
  • Prior experience managing a luxury or ultra-premium product line alongside a mass-market brand, with the ability to navigate dual-brand positioning, pricing, and customer relationships simultaneously.
  • Existing relationships with key Southeast regional builders, developers, and/or distributor networks.
  • Builder trade customer turnaround and business recovery experience — demonstrated ability to re-engage and rebuild strategic accounts.
  • Familiarity with the design and specification influence channel — architects, interior designers, and design-build firms; experience collaborating with national industry associations such as NAHB, NKBA, and ASID.
  • Merchandising and/or marketing leadership experience that complements field sales strategy.
  • Experience developing and executing sales training materials and programs for a field sales organization.
  • Experience presenting to and influencing C-suite and VP-level executives at builder and distributor firms.
  • Proficiency in Salesforce.com, Excel, PowerPoint, and Word; experience with pipeline reporting and sales analytics platforms.

Skills & Leadership Competencies

Skills - Strong leadership and team-building with emphasis on inspiring a high-performance culture in a remote sales environment. Demonstrated analytical skills with the ability to lead and coach others to use data in decision-making. Strong sense of urgency and speed to action. Strong interpersonal, negotiation, and communication skills. Able to assess risks and manage accordingly. Ability to lead complex projects and work effectively in a matrix environment — navigating organizational and trade customer ambiguity with clarity and accountability. Ability to prepare professional written presentations and reports designed for external customers as well as executive reviews. Diplomatic and social skills to interact and navigate with trade customer senior and executive leadership. Demonstrated strategic thinker who can turn strategic objectives into practical field actions. Creating leadership presence — positive and confident influence — with internal functions at all levels of management and with trade customer leadership. Problem-solving orientation: defining the problem to be solved, driving actions and accountabilities through complexity. Ability to adapt within a large corporation that is evolving new functions and channels. P&L management. Proficiency in Salesforce.com, Excel, PowerPoint, and Word. Ability to travel 50%+.

Life @ Samsung -

Benefits @ Samsung -

Regular full-time employees (salaried or hourly) have access to benefits including: Medical, Dental, Vision, Life Insurance, 401(k), Employee Purchase Program, Tuition Assistance (after 12 months), Paid Time Off, Student Loan Program (after 12 months), Wellness Incentives, and many more. The Managing Director, Programs, is a senior executive who reports to the CEO and leads HSI’s global program design and implementation function. The Managing Director serves on the organization’s top management team, along with the CEO and COO, and plays a central role in shaping program strategy, strengthening program quality, supporting business development, and advancing HSI’s mission.

This role supervises a team of highly experienced senior professionals across multiple countries and regions. The Managing Director leads and supports project design and implementation teams, works closely with country and global leaders, and collaborates across the organization to ensure that HSI delivers high-quality, high-impact programs.

This is a key leadership role for a strategic, collaborative, and mission-driven executive who can bring together technical excellence, strong management, sound financial judgment, and a deep commitment to developing people and teams.

What You’ll Do

Organizational Leadership

  • Serve as a trusted thought partner and advisor to the CEO and as a peer to the Chief Operating Officer, contributing to organizational strategy, informed decision-making, revenue generation, and high-quality program execution in support of HSI’s mission.
  • Lead by example as a standard bearer for HSI’s mission, values, integrity, technical excellence, management competence, and emotional intelligence.

  • Work with the CEO and COO for effective business decisions, clear communication, and thoughtful change management across the organization.

  • Demonstrate and uphold HSI’s mission and values in all internal and external activities.

Business Development

  • Contribute actively to new business development by leading selected opportunities, identifying growth areas, and helping secure new funding sources.
  • Lead the development and continuous improvement of HSI’s programmatic strategies and approaches, fostering creativity, collaboration, and quality across country teams, global program leaders, technical advisors, fellows, and partners.
  • Support the cultivation of new funders and partners while helping the organization manage and strengthen existing relationships.
  • Lead selected business development efforts, including positioning, proposal development, partner engagement, and negotiations.
  • Help ensure that new business opportunities are strategically aligned, technically strong, financially viable, and feasible to implement.

Program Execution

  • Lead the Program team to ensure efficient, high-quality, and high-impact implementation of HSI projects.
  • Oversee Program Directors and program operations staff to establish and meet standards for technical excellence, program management quality, financial stewardship, and donor responsiveness.
  • Support country leadership in strengthening HSI’s regional and in-country representation and ensuring effective project implementation.

  • Collaborate with the Leadership Team, Program Directors, and country leaders to ensure that country offices and project teams are appropriately staffed, structured, and supported to succeed.

Team Management

  • Recruit, onboard, supervise, and develop outstanding team members across the Program division.
  • Lead by example, delegate effectively, demonstrate integrity, and motivate and inspire others.
  • Engage respectfully and constructively with staff at all levels of the organization.
  • Manage teams effectively, with a strong focus on staff development, mentoring, coaching, and capacity building.
  • Create and sustain a positive, respectful, inclusive, and accountable team culture.
  • Support senior program staff in navigating complex management challenges, strengthening performance, and growing as leaders.

External Representation

  • Represent HSI at conferences, donor meetings, partner discussions, and other external engagements to strengthen HSI’s reputation, influence, impact, and revenue.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with funders, governments, peer organizations, technical partners, and other stakeholders.
  • Occasionally represent the CEO in internal and external meetings with key stakeholders, as needed.

Your Qualifications

The ideal candidate will bring the following qualifications, experience, and attributes:

  1. A relevant master’s degree with at least 15 years of experience, or a doctoral degree with at least 10 years of experience.
  2. Substantive senior-level experience designing, managing, and overseeing international projects in public, nonprofit, or private sector organizations, preferably in the health sector.
  3. Demonstrated project management expertise, including hands-on experience managing complex projects in challenging operating environments.
  4. Relevant technical experience in areas related to HSI’s work, such as health financing, health policy, health systems strengthening, monitoring and evaluation, strategic purchasing, or related fields.
  5. Ability to communicate technical and programmatic information clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  6. Extensive experience designing programs collaboratively and creatively with partners, governments, bilateral donors, non-traditional funders, philanthropies, and other stakeholders.
  7. Demonstrated ability to lead teams, manage people, mentor staff, coach junior and mid-level professionals, and support the growth of senior leaders.
  8. Executive presence and judgment, with the ability to rally staff around HSI’s mission and priorities and serve as a collaborative business partner to the CEO across and beyond the Program function.
  9. Strong systems thinking, combined with a grounded and pragmatic understanding of the operational, financial, technical, and political complexities of international development and global health work.
  10. Outstanding cross-cultural communication and relationship-building skills, including the ability to work respectfully and effectively with staff across levels, ages, genders, nationalities, identities, orientations, cultures, and areas of expertise.
  11. Ability and willingness to travel up to 20 percent.

Interested staff members are not required to update or submit their CVs. Instead, applicants should provide a one-page statement outlining:

  • Their perspective on HSI’s future strategic direction; and
  • How they would contribute to advancing this direction through the role.
