jobs.title: Vice President, Finance
jobs.excerpt: Reporting to the CFO for Precision AQ (“PAQ”), the VP, Finance – Engagement Solutions will serve as the senior finance lead for the assigned PAQ business unit and will be accountable for translating business strategy into financial plans, forecasts, reporting, and actionable insights in addition to being the lead Finance business partner to the Executive Vice President of Engagement Solutions.
jobs.description:
Reporting to the CFO for Precision AQ (“PAQ”), the VP, Finance – Engagement Solutions will serve as the senior finance lead for the assigned PAQ business unit and will be accountable for translating business strategy into financial plans, forecasts, reporting, and actionable insights in addition to being the lead Finance business partner to the Executive Vice President of Engagement Solutions.

PAQ is comprised of approximately 1,300 employees of which Engagement Solutions represents 630 employees. The business is organized into four business units:

  • Advertising: consulting and advisory services to support large pharma and Bio-Tech brand strategy, omnichannel campaigns, digital and media strategy, etc.
  • Investor Relations Services (IREC): Bio-Tech advisory services to supplement an internal investor relations team or to provide an outsourced investor relations team to support IPO road mapping, buyside and sell-side targeting, investor relations communications, industry events and conferences, analyst education, etc.
  • Medical Communications: communication services for scientific platform development, KOL identification and engagement, peer to peer strategy and tactics, and competitive intelligence services.
  • Market Access: consulting and advisory services for large Pharma and Bio-Techs to support payer value message development, channel strategy and management, payer resources, access and affordability support, and account manager tools.

The VP, FinanceEngagement Solutions is responsible for leading budgeting and forecasting, month end reporting, developing financial analysis and insights, and collaborating with the Engagement Solutions executive management team to support each business unit’s growth objectives. The Engagement Solutions FP&A team will report directly into this role while the Client Finance and Accounting teams provide support via a matrixed organizational structure. The role requires a finance leader who can operate as a hands-on strategic partner, challenge assumptions constructively, identify risks and opportunities early, and convert financial data into clear recommendations for senior leaders. The successful candidate will bring strong commercial orientation, operational and process discipline, client-first judgment, and the leadership presence required to influence across PAQ and PMG while developing a scalable, high-performing finance team.

Main Duties and Responsibilities

  • Serve as a senior member of the Engagement Solutions Executive leadership team and act as the primary finance business partner in the development and management of the business unit’s vision and short- and long-term objectives.
  • Support the service line, business unit, segment and parent teams by translating strategy into financial plans, operating metrics, investment and staffing decisions, resource allocation, and performance actions.
  • Identify and communicate risks and opportunities in the forecast and help mitigate business unit risk to ensure revenue and EBITDA targets are met.
  • Lead the annual budget process and quarterly reforecasting for assigned business unit using both top-down expectations and bottom-up operating detail, linking business strategy, projecting revenue and expense assessing risks, opportunities, and recommended actions with a high level of accuracy.
  • Partner with business-unit leaders to present monthly financial results and forecast updates to PAQ and PMG leadership in a timely and accurate manner.
  • Proactively perform ad hoc qualitative and quantitative analysis to identify and drive key insights and innovative opportunities for P&L and operational improvement.
  • Lead cross-functional finance and business transformation initiatives from concept through execution.
  • Evaluate current-state processes, operating metrics, project financial performance, staffing models, revenue trends, and market or competitor dynamics to identify improvement opportunities and inform financial recommendations.
  • Lead the creation, refinement, and adoption of KPIs, dashboards, and reporting package contents to improve visibility, accountability, and decision making across the finance function and assigned business units.
  • Lead and support continual improvement initiatives, process standardization, reporting discipline, training, system enhancements, and finance transformation efforts across assigned business areas.
  • Adapt to and balance workload in an environment where priorities change while managing expectations of internal and external clients through frequent communication and thought partnership.
  • Establish a results-oriented management style that measures and evaluates individual performance against clearly defined accountable competencies, responsibilities, and objectives.
  • Foster a high performing and collaborative work environment setting performance goals, providing guidance, and promoting continuous learning and development.
  • Promote a culture of rigorous and disciplined financial analysis relying on quantitative data to support business decisions.
  • Ensure sufficient resources, tools and processes are in place to scale a strong finance team and support upgraded business-unit finance expectations.
  • And other job duties as assigned by the line manager.

Education & Experience:

  • 10-15 years of professional finance experience, including substantial FP&A leadership, business-unit finance ownership, and experience supporting multi-service consulting, communications, data, or life sciences organizations with revenues of $300M or greater.
  • Minimum: Undergraduate degree in finance, accounting, or a related field.
  • Advanced business degree or CPA is a plus.
  • Industry experience in professional life sciences services is a plus.
  • Or equivalent combination of education, professional training and experience that provides the individual with the required knowledge, skills, and abilities to perform the job.
  • Deep knowledge of FP&A, Client Finance, project financial management, forecasting, budgeting, reporting, backlog analysis, staffing leverage, and business-unit profitability drivers.
  • Strong understanding of accounting principles, financial controls, revenue recognition, compliance expectations, and finance best practices.
  • Experience with ERP systems, financial planning tools, and data visualization platforms such as Infor and Power BI.
  • Intellectually curious, commercially driven, and confident in translating complex financial information into clear, compelling business narratives.
  • Demonstrated ability to influence senior business leaders by identifying risks and opportunities, challenging assumptions constructively, and helping leaders think differently about business performance.
  • Quick study with strong strategic thinking, analytical judgment, problem-solving capability, and the ability to operate effectively in ambiguous or fast-changing environments.
  • Continuous improvement mindset with the ability to challenge existing processes, simplify ways of working, and identify opportunities to add value and position the organization for success.
  • Willing and able to operate as both a strategic leader and hands-on contributor, ensuring deliverables are completed with quality, accuracy, and timeliness.
  • Focused, disciplined leader and team builder who can drive pace, accountability, and execution across a complex matrix organization.
  • Trusted team player who builds credibility through business partnership, execution, follow-through, and measurable results.
  • Executive presence and the ability to remain calm and solution-oriented under pressure.
  • Strong leadership skills with the ability to attract, retain, develop, and coach high-performing finance talent.

Travel Requirement: Expect some travel to business-unit headquarters or satellite office, leadership meetings, or client/operating locations as needed; estimated at approximately 10%.

jobs.title: Senior Quality Assurance Lead
jobs.excerpt: Estamos buscando uma Pessoa Líder Sênior de Garantia de Qualidade para construir um moderno Centro de Excelência em QA para a organização AST.
jobs.description:
Estamos buscando uma Pessoa Líder Sênior de Garantia de Qualidade para construir um moderno Centro de Excelência em QA para a organização AST. Essa função utilizará automação e IA para transformar a qualidade de uma função de validação manual em uma capacidade de propriedade da engenharia, incorporada em todo o ciclo de vida do desenvolvimento de software. A Pessoa Líder Sênior de Garantia de Qualidade definirá padrões de QA, estratégia de automação, fluxos de trabalho de testes assistidos por IA, portas de qualidade de CI/CD, painéis de controle e sistemas de feedback que ajudem as equipes a detectar riscos mais cedo e reduzir os testes manuais. Esse líder trabalhará em estreita parceria com as lideranças de Produto, Engenharia e Hand Talk para aumentar a confiança nos lançamentos, fortalecer o senso de responsabilidade dos desenvolvedores pela qualidade e ajudar a organização a amadurecer em direção a um modelo operacional no qual a qualidade esteja incorporada à forma como as equipes projetam, desenvolvem, testam e operam o software.

Trabalhamos todos os dias com gente muito talentosa focada no mesmo propósito: tornar o mundo um lugar mais acessível e justo para todas as pessoas. Valorizamos a colaboratividade e temos um gigante espírito de equipe, mesmo à distância temos muita proximidade com todos e todas. Venha compartilhar conhecimento e impactar a vida de milhares de pessoas no Brasil e em todo o planeta.

Da fusão entre Hand Talk e Sorenson nasceu o ASLT, um hub de inovação, onde contamos com profissionais incríveis trabalhando com tecnologia de ponta para desenvolver e entregar serviços de ponta em tradução de língua de sinais impulsionados por IA, que possibilitem a comunicação bidirecional em tempo real, promovendo oportunidades inclusivas para todos que interagem com a tecnologia!

Então se você quer fazer parte dessa missão de quebrar barreiras de comunicação entre pessoas surdas e ouvintes através da tecnologia no mundo inteiro, trabalhe conosco e conheça mais daHand Talk by Sorenson!

  • Um ambiente altamente desafiador e colaborativo.
  • Possibilidade de aprendizado e crescimento acelerado, com oportunidade de implementar projetos que serão cases de sucesso no mundo digital.

Visite nosso blog, canal no Youtube, redes sociais ou dá um Google aí que também vai achar muita coisa bacana sobre a Hand Talk by Sorenson!

Responsabilidades Principais:

  • • Definir e liderar a visão de um moderno Centro de Excelência em Controle de Qualidade que utilizeautomação e IA para reduzir a dependência da validação manual e incorporar a qualidade em todo o ciclo de vida do desenvolvimento de software.
  • • Estabelecer padrões de qualidade, estratégia de testes, arquitetura de automação e critérios de prontidão para lançamento em testes de interface do usuário (UI), API, integração, regressão, exploratórios e não funcionais.
  • • Criar e aprimorar fluxos de trabalho de QA assistidos por IA, incluindo geração de testes, rastreabilidade de requisitos para testes, análise de falhas, triagem de defeitos, seleção de regressão baseada em risco e manutenção da automação.
  • • Trabalhar em parceria com desenvolvedores para antecipar os testes, aprimorando os critérios de aceitação, a testabilidade, a cobertura de testes unitários e de integração, a validação no nível de pull request e a automação de responsabilidade dos desenvolvedores.
  • • Integre testes automatizados e portas de qualidade em pipelines de CI/CD para que as equipes recebam feedback rápido e confiável antes da fusão, durante as execuções noturnas e antes do lançamento.
  • • Crie painéis de qualidade e sistemas de relatórios que mostrem a integridade do produto, a cobertura de automação, o status da regressão, as tendências de defeitos, testes instáveis, riscos de lançamento e oportunidades de melhoria.
  • • Projete um pipeline noturno automatizado de controle de qualidade capaz de ser executado nas bases de código dos produtos, identificando falhas, registrando bugs passíveis de correção e publicando o status de qualidade sem a necessidade de documentação manual de aprovação/reprovação.
  • • Liderar a avaliação, a seleção e o uso responsável de ferramentas de QA, plataformas de teste habilitadas para IA, estruturas de automação, abordagens de dados de teste e sistemas de relatórios.
  • • Orientar os membros da equipe de QA e os desenvolvedores em práticas de qualidade que priorizam a automação e são habilitadas por IA, desenvolvendo a capacidade da equipe em vez de centralizar todo o trabalho de testes dentro do QA.
  • • Trabalhar em parceria com as equipes de Produto, Engenharia, DevOps e a liderança para priorizar investimentos em qualidade e comunicar riscos.

    • Habilidades Técnicas:

  • • Experiência em funções de garantia de qualidade de software, engenharia dequalidade, SDET, automação de testes ou engenharia de software, incluindo experiência prática no projeto, desenvolvimento ou manutenção de estruturas de testes automatizados.
  • • Experiência em liderança técnica na definição de estratégias de garantia de qualidade, orientação de engenheiros de controle de qualidade ou desenvolvedores, integração de controles de qualidade em pipelines de CI/CD ou liderança de iniciativas de transformação em engenharia de qualidade.
  • • Sólida experiência prática com automação moderna de testes para interface do usuário (UI), API, integração, regressão e testes de ponta a ponta, utilizando ferramentas como Playwright, Cypress, Selenium, Postman, PyTest ou frameworks similares.
  • • Experiência na integração de testes automatizados em pipelines de CI/CD, como GitHub Actions, GitLab, Jenkins, Azure DevOps ou plataformas semelhantes.
  • • Capacidade de definir uma estratégia de qualidade que priorize a automação, reduzindo a validação manual e aumentando o envolvimento dos desenvolvedores nos testes.
  • • Conhecimento prático de engenharia de qualidade assistida por IA, incluindo geração de testes com suporte de IA, análise de falhas, triagem de defeitos, rastreabilidade de requisitos para testes, seleção de regressão baseada em risco e manutenção da automação.
  • • Sólida habilidade em programação ou scripting em linguagens como TypeScript, JavaScript, Python, Java ou linguagens semelhantes utilizadas para automação de testes e ferramentas.
  • • Experiência no projeto de painéis de qualidade, métricas de prontidão para lançamento, relatórios de tendências de defeitos, relatórios de cobertura de automação e outros sistemas de feedback que tornam visível a integridade do produto
  • • Capacidade de colaborar efetivamente com as equipes de Produto, Engenharia, DevOps, Controle de Qualidade e liderança para esclarecer requisitos, identificar riscos antecipadamente e incorporar práticas de qualidade em todo o ciclo de vida do desenvolvimento de software.
  • • Sólido entendimento de testes “shift-left”, testabilidade, critérios de aceitação, testes exploratórios, testes não funcionais e avaliação de riscos de lançamento.
  • • Capacidade de orientar membros da equipe de QA e desenvolvedores em práticas de qualidade que priorizam a automação e são habilitadas por IA, sem centralizar toda a responsabilidade pelos testes dentro da equipe de QA.
  • • Sólidas habilidades de comunicação escrita e verbal, incluindo a capacidade de explicar riscos de qualidade, compromissos e oportunidades de melhoria tanto para partes interessadas técnicas quanto não técnicas.

La société, dont le siège social est à Brisbane, en Australie, possède des activités de voyages d'affaires et de loisirs dans 23 pays, couvrant l'Australie, la Nouvelle-Zélande, les Amériques, l'Europe, le Royaume-Uni, l'Afrique du Sud, les Émirats arabes unis et l'Asie. FCTG exploite également un réseau mondial de gestion de voyages d'affaires, qui s'étend à plus de 90 pays par l'intermédiaire d'entreprises détenues par l'entreprise et de titulaires de licence indépendants. La société a ouvert sa première agence de voyages d'agrément à Sydney, en Australie, en 1982 et a été cotée à la Bourse australienne en 1995. Notre objectif est « d'ouvrir le monde à ceux qui veulent le voir ». Chaque jour, on offre aux gens du monde entier l'occasion de vivre quelque chose de vraiment incroyable : voyager !

Through SALT Access, our integrated creative agency, we translate market access and commercialization strategies into compelling, effective multichannel marketing, design, and communications, with a focus on value and access messaging. Blue Matter, together with SALT Access, fosters an entrepreneurial culture and is committed to being one of the best places to work.

We are seeking an experienced, hands-on Market Access Content & Account Lead to join our growing agency team supporting pharmaceutical and life sciences clients.

This is a role for a driven, self-sufficient communicator who thrives in an entrepreneurial environment. You will own client relationships day to day — listening closely, asking the right questions, and distilling client requests into clear, actionable direction for manuscript development and the creative team. You don’t need to build market access strategy from scratch, but you must “speak strategy” fluently enough to ensure our creative output resonates with key audience segments, including payers, healthcare professionals (HCPs), formulary decision-makers, and organized customers.

This role acts as the critical bridge between the client, market access strategy, and creative execution. You will blend deep fluency in the market access landscape with expert manuscript development, messaging, and content strategy to transform client requests and high-level consulting inputs into persuasive, compliant materials (e.g., value decks, pull-through tools, educational resources, multichannel engagement tactics) that clearly articulate a therapy’s value, simplify the path to reimbursement, and ultimately drive patient access across the healthcare ecosystem.

Because we operate as a lean, high-growth agency, you will be expected to run projects with minimal oversight — bringing established expertise, sound judgment, and the confidence to make calls independently based on solid, demonstrable experience.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Account & Client Management (primary focus)
  • Serve as a primary day-to-day client contact, building trusted relationships and anticipating client needs
  • Lead client discussions to gather insights, clarify objectives, and pressure-test requests before work begins
  • Distill client requests — often ambiguous or high-level — into precise, actionable briefs and content direction for manuscript development and the creative team
  • Manage client expectations proactively around scope, timelines, feedback cycles, and MLR requirements
  • Provide “on-the-spot” content recommendations in client meetings, backed by market access expertise
  • Identify opportunities to expand and deepen client engagements
Project Management & Creative Collaboration
  • Work closely with designers and production teams to ensure copy and visuals integrate seamlessly for maximum impact
  • Work closely with agency project management and traffic team to manage timelines and deliverables across multiple concurrent projects with minimal oversight
  • Serve as the “Strategic Guardrail” during the creative process, ensuring that design elements enhance rather than distract from the core access message
Manuscript & Content Development (primary focus)
  • Interpret and apply strategic inputs from clients and consulting teams to develop brand narratives that resonate with payer stakeholders
  • Own manuscript development end to end: synthesize, outline, draft, edit, and finalize content manuscripts — complete, referenced, annotated copy documents — that serve as the blueprint for the art team’s design and execution of each deliverable
  • Write clear, accurate, and persuasive content for market access audiences, including payers, formulary decision-makers, HCPs, and policy influencers
  • Translate complex clinical, health economics, and policy information into concise, engaging messages and narratives tailored to specific audiences
  • Lead the drafting and development of core market access materials, including, but not limited to: payer value propositions; reimbursement, billing, medical exceptions, and coverage guides; objection handlers; formulary flashcards; HEOR and RWE data summaries; patient access brochures and educational materials; prior authorization forms and instructions; pull-through toolkits; payer and HCP email campaigns; interactive PDFs; infographics; leave-behinds; sales aid copy; payer- and HCP-focused microsite content; and training slide decks for account teams
  • Deliver manuscripts that are “design-ready” — with clear structure, hierarchy, callouts, references, and annotations — so the creative team can execute efficiently and accurately
  • Maintain manuscript quality and consistency across concurrent projects, from first draft through MLR submission and final release
  • Ensure content aligns with brand tone, compliance guidelines, and legal/regulatory requirements (e.g., FDA, OPDP
Quality & Compliance
  • Support the medical/legal/regulatory (MLR) review process, incorporating feedback while maintaining clarity and persuasiveness
DESIRED EXPERIENCE & SKILLS
  • 5–8+ Years of Healthcare Communications: Proven, verifiable track record in pharmaceutical or healthcare messaging, with deep roots in Market Access, Payer Marketing, or HEOR communications — this role requires established expertise, not on-the-job learning of the fundamentals
  • Client Management Experience: Demonstrated success owning client relationships in an agency or consultancy setting, including translating loosely defined client asks into structured briefs and deliverables
  • Entrepreneurial Self-Sufficiency: A self-starter who operates with urgency and minimal direction, comfortable with ambiguity, and accountable for outcomes from kickoff through delivery
  • Exceptional Manuscript & Writing Skills: Ability to serve as a “Strategic Storyteller,” with a portfolio demonstrating the ability to turn complex pharmaceutical data into persuasive, clear, and audience-appropriate content — and to structure that content into design-ready manuscripts that art and production teams can execute against
  • Data Translation Expertise: Mastery in interpreting clinical data, health economics, and policy shifts, with the ability to translate these “strategic inputs” for non-clinical payer and provider audiences
  • U.S. Payer Landscape Literacy: A functional understanding of the U.S. reimbursement ecosystem, including formulary decision-making, PBM dynamics, coding/billing pathways, and value-based messaging
  • Creative Collaboration: Experience partnering with art directors, designers, and digital production teams to develop integrated campaigns where copy and visuals work in tandem
  • MLR & Technical Proficiency: Deep experience navigating the Medical/Legal/Regulatory (MLR) review process, including working competency within the Veeva Vault platform for submissions and markups
  • Regulatory Rigor: Solid working knowledge of industry compliance standards, including fair balance, ISI requirements, referencing standards, and the distinction between promotional and non-promotional materials
PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
  • Educational Background: Bachelor’s degree in Communications, Life Sciences, Marketing, or Journalism; an advanced degree (MPH, MS, MBA, or similar) is highly regarded
  • Agency or Consultancy Experience: Prior experience in a fast-paced agency or strategic consultancy, featuring the confidence to lead client discussions and provide “on-the-spot” content recommendations
  • Startup Agility: Comfortable operating in a “scrappy,” high-growth, or small-agency environment where adaptability is key, deadlines are often tight, and everyone contributes beyond their job description
  • Operational Excellence: Highly organized and detail-oriented, with the ability to manage the nuances of multiple concurrent projects without losing sight of the strategic “big picture”
Compensation: Base salary range: $110,000 - $180,000 depending on experience. Generous incentive compensation structure.

Benefits Package

  • Comprehensive medical, dental and vision coverage options effective day 1 of employment

  • Employee Assistance Program
  • Generous paid time off including vacation, sick days, floating and company holidays

THE POSITION:

EVERSANA is searching for a Research Director, Policy to join the NAVLIN Insights team, which delivers pharmaceutical policy, market access and pricing intelligence to our clients. The role will drive our fast-expanding policy services, including our NAVLIN Daily news service, policy intelligence, MFN tracker and other policy-related activities. This includes client-facing support and business development, as well as end-to-end oversight, production and delivery of the policy services.

Reporting into the SVP of NAVLIN Insights, the role will build on Eversana’s reputation as a leader in global pricing and policy intelligence. It will sit at the intersection of policy expertise, client engagement, and commercial growth, with a specific focus on global pricing, reimbursement, and policy developments (including MFN and related initiatives). The successful candidate will oversee the development and delivery of policy-driven products and services, act as a senior client-facing expert, and contribute to strategic consulting engagements. This role will also play a key part in shaping how AI and advanced analytics are leveraged to enhance NAVLIN’s capabilities and create new, differentiated offerings.

Preference is for U.K.-based (remote or London office) but we will also consider applications from other locations (including Germany, Italy, Spain, Ireland).

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:
Our employees are tasked with delivering excellent business results in collaboration with the broader NAVLIN Insights team. These results are achieved by:

  • Management of the NAVLIN Daily team, which produces daily news that is relied on by thousands of daily users to understand policy, pricing and reimbursement developments around the world every day
  • Policy intelligence leadership, including on MFN (Most Favored Nation) tracking and insights, global pricing & reimbursement policy monitoring, and custom intelligence trackers
  • Oversee delivery of policy intelligence services, including timely updates and responsiveness to breaking policy changes and client support
  • Translate complex policy developments into clear, actionable insights for clients, while ensuring content is high quality, commercially relevant and differentiated
  • Serving as a senior subject matter expert and acting as the policy across cross-functional teams, you will present policy insights to biopharma clients and lead client briefings, webinars and other client-facing activities
  • Support and drive business development activities, including identifying market opportunities, building client relationships, support business cases and proposals; and partner with the commercial teams to position NAVLIN services effectively and contribute meaningfully to revenue growth across policy-driven offerings
  • Contribute to broader EVERSANA consulting engagements, including pricing & market access strategy and policy impact assessments
  • Explore and implement ways to leverage AI and automation to improve efficiency and scalability of policy tracking, enhance insight generation and synthesis as well as develop new AI-enabled products and services within NAVLIN Insights including:
    1. Research - Using AI for research and answering questions, including skills in prompt writing, reducing hallucinations, validating AI answers, experience with multiple models, ability to weigh strengths and weaknesses and appropriateness of using AI in work
    2. Outputs - Using AI for generating and reviewing AI outputs, including generating datasets, PPTs, and briefs from unstructured documents as well as for general productivity, managing To Do lists, meeting summaries, and filtering and responding to e-mails
    3. Writing Agents - Using AI for creating and running AI agents appropriate to the role, including managing one’s one workflow, and/or creating general purpose agents for the team to deliver work, and/or creating agents built to production standards for deployment to customers
  • All other duties as assigned.

EXPECTIONS OF THE JOB:

  • Travel (<2 % or number of days)
  • Hours (40 Hours per week, days of the week)

This is a remote position, but will potentially entail conference and meeting travel and sometimes office days

MINIMUM KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS AND ABILITIES:

The requirements listed below are representative of the experience, education, knowledge, skill and/or abilities required.

  • 6–10+ years of experience in:
    • Health policy, market access, pricing & reimbursement, or related fields
  • Analytical mindset. Strong understanding of:
    • Global pharmaceutical policy landscape
    • Pricing and access dynamics (incl. MFN and similar frameworks)
  • Proven experience in:
    • Client-facing roles (consulting, advisory, or industry)
    • Translating complex policy into business implications
  • Strong communication and presentation skills
  • Familiarity with data analytics or AI-enabled workflows

OUR CULTURAL BELIEFS:

Patient Minded I act with the patient’s best interest in mind.

Client Delight I own every client experience and its impact on results.

Take Action I am empowered and empower others to act now.

Grow Talent I own my development and invest in the development of others. 

Win Together I passionately connect with anyone, anywhere, anytime to achieve results.

Communication Matters I speak up to create transparent, thoughtful and timely dialogue.

Embrace Diversity I create an environment of awareness and respect.

Always Innovate I am bold and creative in everything I do.

Our team is aware of recent fraudulent job offers in the market, misrepresenting EVERSANA. Recruitment fraud is a sophisticated scam commonly perpetrated through online services using fake websites, unsolicited e-mails, or even text messages claiming to be a legitimate company. Some of these scams request personal information and even payment for training or job application fees. Please know EVERSANA would never require personal information nor payment of any kind during the employment process. We respect the personal rights of all candidates looking to explore careers at EVERSANA.

From EVERSANA’s inception, Diversity, Equity & Inclusion have always been key to our success. We are an Equal Opportunity Employer, and our employees are people with different strengths, experiences, and backgrounds who share a passion for improving the lives of patients and leading innovation within the healthcare industry. Diversity not only includes race and gender identity, but also age, disability status, veteran status, sexual orientation, religion, and many other parts of one’s identity. All of our employees’ points of view are key to our success, and inclusion is everyone's responsibility.

Follow us on LinkedIn | Twitter

At EVERSANA, we are proud to be certified as a Great Place to Work across the globe. We’re fueled by our vision to create a healthier world. How? Our global team of more than 7,000 employees is committed to creating and delivering next-generation commercialization services to the life sciences industry. We are grounded in our cultural beliefs and serve more than 650 clients ranging from innovative biotech start-ups to established pharmaceutical companies. Our products, services and solutions help bring innovative therapies to market and support the patients who depend on them. Our jobs, skills and talents are unique, but together we make an impact every day. Join us!

Across our growing organization, we embrace diversity in backgrounds and experiences. Improving patient lives around the world is a priority, and we need people from all backgrounds and swaths of life to help build the future of the healthcare and the life sciences industry. We believe our people make all the difference in cultivating an inclusive culture that embraces our cultural beliefs. We are deliberate and self-reflective about the kind of team and culture we are building. We look for team members that are not only strong in their own aptitudes but also who care deeply about EVERSANA, our people, clients and most importantly, the patients we serve. We are EVERSANA.

EDI Specialist Position Summary

The EDI Specialist provides operational support to production practices and resolves issues as assigned or deemed necessary. Must coordinate with various departments and document, analyze, and assist in efficient resolution of all production processes. This includes responding to end-user issues and inquiries in support, working with both in-house and third-party applications. In this role, the EDI Specialist will work closely with others to identify, communicate, and document issues and their resolutions in the production ticket tracking system.

  • Why does this role matter?
    The EDI Specialist monitors production pipelines, catches failures before they reach clients, and works across internal departments and external vendors to keep transactions flowing correctly. When this work goes well, clients don't notice. When the processes breaks, claims get rejected, payments stall, and client trust erodes.
  • What impact will the new hire have in their first 6 months?
    In the first 90 days, cross-training with each of the EDI team members building an understanding of each task, focusing on learning file transaction types, becoming familiar with using various systems, applications and tools, and gaining an understanding of each internal department that the EDI team engages with to meet the KPI for each assigned task.
    From month four to six, the EDI Specialist is handling ticket queues independently, identifying recurring error patterns, and contributing fixes that prevent the same issues from recurring.
  • What's the growth trajectory for this position?
    The EDI Specialist role provides a strong pathway for growth within Operations. Associates who develop deep transaction knowledge and a track record for clean documentation and cross-team collaboration move into senior specialist or supervisor roles. From there, the path opens toward Operations leadership or technical project work with Trading Partners and Payers.

What You'll Be Doing as an EDI Specialist

  • Provide operational support to production practices and issues and suggest areas for improvement.
  • Monitor, review, troubleshoot, and correct EDI issues and make necessary changes to prevent the same issues from reoccurring.
  • Perform tests on production applications and prepare recovery procedures for applications.
  • Coordinate with IT groups and external vendors to ensure effective services for reliability.
  • Analyze business processes and ensure compliance with controlled processes according to established protocols.
  • Monitor alerts and escalate issues for procedures and systems.
  • Assist as needed with training guides and supporting other team members.

    • Be Humble: DentalXChange Associates are humble. They lack excessive ego or concerns about status. They are quick to point out the contributions of others and slow to seek recognition for their own. They share credit, emphasize team over self, and define success collectively rather than individually.
    • Feedback is a Gift: DentalXChange Associates view feedback as a gift, an opportunity for growth. They actively seek feedback to improve DXC, their teams, and themselves. They offer feedback generously and thoughtfully, always with respect and the intent to help others. They embrace feedback, welcoming a new viewpoint or idea, with the understanding it is for the greater good of the company and rooted in trusted relationships.

jobs.title: Senior Security Operations Engineer
jobs.excerpt: Senior Security Operations EngineerAbout the RoleSunCore Digital is seeking a hands-on Senior Security Operations Engineer to assess and improve the security of our applications, cloud environments, development practices, identities, data, and operational tooling.
jobs.description:
Senior Security Operations Engineer

About the Role

SunCore Digital is seeking a hands-on Senior Security Operations Engineer to assess and improve the security of our applications, cloud environments, development practices, identities, data, and operational tooling.

This role will establish practical security standards, build and harden shared security controls, investigate risk, and review security-impacting implementations produced by reliability, recovery, DevOps, and application teams. System-owning teams remain responsible for remediating their applications and services and for operating routine system-specific controls after enablement.

This is not a role that manually approves every normal software release. Security review will focus on defined risk areas, including changes involving privileged access, sensitive data, recovery systems, network exposure, secrets, infrastructure, authentication, authorization, and security controls.

Responsibilities

Security assessment

  • Assess the current security posture across web applications, Flutter mobile applications, APIs, backend services, cloud infrastructure, repositories, CI/CD, databases, and integrations.

  • Inventory externally accessible services and endpoints.

  • Identify vulnerabilities, insecure defaults, excessive permissions, unmanaged credentials, and control gaps.

  • Distinguish confirmed findings from suspected risks and unassessed areas.

  • Prioritize findings based on exploitability, potential impact, exposure, and launch relevance.

  • Define remediation requirements and work with system owners, who implement and maintain application- and service-specific fixes. Implement shared security controls where the control belongs to the security function.

  • Verify that critical findings are resolved effectively.

Identity and access management

  • Review access to cloud accounts, repositories, databases, CI/CD systems, production environments, and third-party services.

  • Identify former employee, contractor, shared, excessive, or undocumented access.

  • Establish least-privilege and access-review practices.

  • Review service accounts, machine identities, API credentials, and privileged roles.

  • Define and harden credential lifecycle requirements, and work with DevOps, platform staff, and system owners to implement appropriate issuance, storage, rotation, revocation, and emergency-access mechanisms.

  • Ensure critical access activity is logged where appropriate.

  • Support role-based access and authorization reviews.

Application and API security

  • Review authentication, authorization, session management, permissions, and data isolation.

  • Assess exposed APIs, input handling, file processing, sensitive-data handling, and administrative functions.

  • Independently assess high-risk negative-access paths and direct access to restricted endpoints.

  • Work with QA and developers to convert repeatable security scenarios into regression coverage owned by the applicable delivery team.

  • Review changes involving sensitive workflows or new public exposure.

  • Help establish secure coding and review expectations.

  • Support threat modeling for critical workflows and material architectural changes.

Mobile security

  • Assess mobile authentication, session handling, secure storage, API access, application permissions, logging, and sensitive-data exposure.

  • Review risks related to device storage, screenshots, notifications, local caches, and mobile configuration.

  • Work with the Mobile QA Engineer and mobile developers on security-related testing.

  • Review mobile release practices where they affect application security.

Security tooling and automation

  • Define, implement, and harden security-specific automation, including dependency scanning, secret scanning, static analysis, vulnerability scanning, and container or infrastructure scanning where appropriate; establish the long-term owner for each shared control before handoff.

  • Define security policies, rules, and acceptance thresholds; work with DevOps to integrate shared controls into CI/CD and with repository owners to maintain application-specific configuration.

  • Establish actionable security gates based on severity and context, while system owners remain responsible for remediation.

  • Avoid creating low-value controls that block delivery without reducing material risk.

  • Improve security finding visibility and reporting.

  • Define exception and escalation procedures.

  • Track critical remediation through verification.

Review of reliability and recovery implementations

  • Review security-impacting SRE and Disaster Recovery implementations before production adoption.

  • Evaluate changes involving:

    • Privileged automation

    • Service accounts

    • Secrets

    • Backup data

    • Recovery access

    • Network or firewall configuration

    • Infrastructure permissions

    • Failover paths

    • Sensitive logging or monitoring

  • Review DevOps, dashboard, and internal-tooling changes when they affect access, production data, infrastructure, or security controls.

  • Validate that operational improvements do not introduce avoidable security exposure.

Security operations and incident readiness

  • Establish security monitoring and escalation requirements.

  • Develop security incident-response procedures and runbooks.

  • Define initial security incident severity and notification paths.

  • Investigate security events and suspicious activity.

  • Support evidence preservation and technical incident analysis.

  • Conduct or coordinate security exercises.

  • Track post-incident corrective actions.

  • Ensure security runbooks are tested by qualified staff.

Data and vendor security

  • Identify where sensitive, personal, financial, or operational data is stored and transmitted.

  • Review encryption in transit and at rest.

  • Assess retention, deletion, export, logging, and access behavior.

  • Review third-party services that receive code, credentials, operational data, or sensitive information.

  • Support vendor security review based on business risk.

  • Help identify security and privacy obligations that require legal or compliance input.

Collaboration

  • Work with developers to remediate application findings.

  • Work with SRE on logging, monitoring, incident readiness, and security-relevant reliability controls.

  • Work with the Disaster Recovery and Resilience Engineer on backup, restoration, emergency access, and recovery security.

  • Define security requirements for CI/CD and shared infrastructure; work with DevOps and platform staff to implement them, and with system owners to maintain application-specific configuration.

  • Work with QA on permissions, authorization, data isolation, and regression scenarios.

  • Provide clear technical findings and risk information to leadership.

Initial Priorities

  • Inventory production access, service accounts, secrets, and publicly accessible endpoints.

  • Review former employee, contractor, and shared access.

  • Establish and harden shared dependency- and secret-scanning capabilities, coordinate CI/CD integration with DevOps, and assign remediation ownership to the applicable repository teams.

  • Assess authentication, authorization, and customer-data isolation.

  • Review critical cloud and infrastructure permissions.

  • Identify launch-critical security findings.

  • Establish security review triggers for high-risk changes.

  • Implement initial security monitoring and incident procedures.

  • Review SRE and recovery mitigations that affect production security.

  • Create a factual security-readiness assessment.

Required Qualifications

  • Five or more years of experience in security engineering, DevSecOps, cloud security, application security, security operations, or a comparable role.

  • Hands-on experience remediating security issues.

  • Experience securing cloud-hosted applications and infrastructure.

  • Experience reviewing authentication, authorization, permissions, and data isolation.

  • Experience with CI/CD security integration.

  • Experience with vulnerability, dependency, secret, and static-analysis tooling.

  • Strong understanding of identity, access, service accounts, secrets, and least privilege.

  • Experience reviewing web applications and APIs.

  • Familiarity with mobile application security.

  • Experience with security monitoring and incident response.

  • Ability to assess third-party and operational security risks.

  • Strong technical documentation and communication skills.

  • Ability to distinguish confirmed vulnerabilities, suspected risks, and unassessed areas.

  • Comfort working in a small organization where security practices are still being established.

Bonus Points

  • Experience preparing a platform for its first external users.

  • Experience establishing security practices in a startup or small engineering organization.

  • Familiarity with crypto, fintech, digital assets, KYC, AML, or payment-related systems.

  • Experience with Flutter or mobile application security.

  • Experience securing disaster-recovery, backup, or privileged automation systems.

  • Experience with infrastructure as code or containerized platforms.

  • Experience in a remote, asynchronous environment.

What Success Looks Like

  • Production access, privileged identities, service accounts, and secrets are inventoried.

  • Former and excessive access is removed.

  • Critical repositories and systems have appropriate automated security scanning.

  • Authentication, authorization, and data-isolation risks are understood.

  • Launch-critical security findings are visible and remediated or explicitly accepted.

  • Security-impacting SRE and recovery implementations are reviewed before adoption.

  • Security controls are practical, documented, and integrated into engineering workflows.

  • The organization has a tested security incident process.

  • Security does not depend on undocumented knowledge or manual review of every routine release.

Compensation & Benefits

● Base Compensation: Competitive, based on experience, portfolio strength, and geographic location.

● Milestone Bonuses:10% milestone bonus awarded to every team member assisting with the MVP build-out.

● Annual Performance Bonus: Represents a significant percentage of total compensation.

● Benefits for Domestic Hires: Health, dental, and vision plans.

● Annual Paid Offsite: Team retreats in Caribbean, Hawaii, ski destinations, and other exciting locations.

Why Join SunCore Digital?

● High-impact role in a rapidly scaling digital company.

● Fully remote team with async flexibility.

● Direct collaboration with executive leadership and best-in-class marketing/design partners.

● Opportunity to shape Security processes and mentor junior team members.

● Competitive compensation with performance upside.

At Memorial Hermann, we pursue a common goal of delivering high quality, efficient care while creating exceptional experiences for every member of our community. When we say every member of our community, that includes our employees. We know that when our employees feel cared for, heard and valued, they are inspired to create moments that exceed expectations, while prioritizing safety, compassion, personalization and efficiency. If you want to advance your career and contribute to our vision of creating healthier communities, now and for generations to come, we want you to be a part of our team.

Job Summary

As an integral member of the Analytics Team, the Senior Specialized Business Intelligence (BI) Analyst is responsible for creating advanced, information-based, business intelligence deliverables that will be relied upon by organizational leaders to support critical business decisions. The Senior Specialized BI Analyst will provide domain expertise in one or more specific areas, as required for the position, such as: clinical, consumer experience, finance, human resources, marketing, medical insurance, operational effectiveness and/or supply chain. This position will primarily work, but not exclusively, with customers across the organization in clinical, administrative and/or operational areas to provide analytical insights from reports and/or dashboard visualizations to facilitate discovery of new opportunities, support data-informed decision-making for identified challenges as well as develop new and enhance existing metrics to analyze ongoing performance metrics.

The Senior Specialized BI Analyst will be tasked with domain-specific requests to support transformation of data and information into actionable insights that answer complex business questions. This position will communicate insights and opportunities to leadership, analytical needs to technical teams, as well as serve as a domain expert and mentor to other team members supporting projects that are outside their specialized domain. This position will work with customers to understand and define the problems being solved, procure and integrate the data sources necessary to analyze the needs appropriately, deliver relevant analytics tools to meet customer’s objectives, implement and support the solutions for ongoing utilization.

The Senior Business Analyst partners with clinical, operational, and technical teams to deliver data-driven solutions that improve business processes and support strategic decision-making across the health system. This role serves as a key liaison between stakeholders and technical teams, facilitating meetings, gathering business needs, supporting users, and translating complex information into actionable solutions. The ideal candidate is a collaborative relationship builder with strong communication, problem-solving, and critical thinking skills who thrives in a fast-paced environment and is eager to learn emerging technologies, including predictive analytics and AI.

Job Description

MEMORIAL HERMANN CANNOT HIRE REMOTE WORKERS IN THE FOLLOWING STATES:

Arizona, California, Connecticut, Maryland, Massachusetts, Missouri, New Jersey, New York, Utah, Ohio, Pennsylvania, Washington, Alabama, Mississippi, Illinois, Oregon, Arkansas or Iowa

Desired Skill Set

  • Strong interpersonal, communication, and relationship-building skills with the ability to collaborate effectively across technical and non-technical teams.

  • Proven ability to facilitate meetings, gather business requirements, and translate complex concepts into practical solutions.

  • Customer-focused, proactive problem solver with strong critical thinking skills and a willingness to take initiative.

  • Experience supporting clinical or healthcare operations and an understanding of clinical workflows is preferred.

  • Interest in emerging technologies, including predictive analytics and AI, with a continuous learning mindset.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS

Education: Bachelor’s degree, preferably in computer science, management information systems, data science, business administration, statistics, or related field or equivalent experience required. Master’s degree preferred.

Licenses/Certifications: Associate Certified Analytics Professional (aCAP) or another vendor-neutral analytics certification preferred. Applicable certification or accreditation for domain expertise strongly preferred.

Experience / Knowledge / Skills:

  • Minimum of 5 years professional experience providing similar analytics services for this role to one or more domain areas, as needed.

  • Minimum of 5 years professional experience collaborating with customers on the design, creation and execution of analytics deliverables.

  • Minimum of 5 years professional experience in building self-service analytic reports, dashboards and/or tools supporting decision-making and actionable metric monitoring by customers.

  • Demonstrated experience and successful results from working in a dynamic, matrixed organization with executive exposure.

  • Advanced proficiency with the following tools, as necessary for position:

    • MS Office Suite: Excel (Pivot tables, VBA, Macros), Word, PowerPoint, Visio, Access (Required)

    • Database querying: SQL

    • Visualization tools – Tableau (preferred), Sisense, Qlik or Microsoft PowerBI

    • Statistical tools - R, Python, SAS, SPSS or other statistical tools for data analysis. (Preferred)

  • Demonstrated critical thinking and advanced creative problem-solving skills and aptitude to exert influence without authority through interpreting requirements and guiding customers to the desired analytics outcomes.

  • Analytic mindset able to draw conclusions from raw data and summarize and present results efficiently using logic and reasoning to identify approaches to problems.

  • Ability to visualize data in a meaningful way to communicate effectively the meaning and the necessary action to be taken.

  • Act with an intellectual curiosity to obtain insights from data and search for solutions to the problems being explored as well as new ones to be discovered.

  • Understand math and statistical concepts to provide analysis to formulate meaningful decisions.

  • Exceptional time management skills and attention to detail.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, specifically with an ability to communicate effectively across multiple management levels.

  • Proven ability to work independently and as part of a team under established deadlines to drive critical outcomes.

  • Create a positive work environment that fosters successful team performance.

  • Strong customer service, interpersonal and relationship-building skills.

PRINCIPAL ACCOUNTABILITIES

  • Serve as the analytics domain expert for assigned area(s) and advise/support others in support of efforts for the domain.

  • Act as advisor and mentor to others offering high level support, mentorship, education and training.

  • Ongoing interactions with customers, leadership and teams across the organization to enhance knowledge of business, clinical and administrative processes and applications utilized by the various clients.

  • Partner with respective customers to identify analytics insights, communicate insights and opportunities across system organizational matrix, in support of system strategic goals.

  • Partner with customers and technical teams to design, develop and implement the analytics insights and tools in support of actionable, operational, strategic and tactical metrics for optimization.

  • Partner with the greater Analytics team to evolve Memorial Hermann’s Analytics Maturity Level to incorporate the full analytics spectrum of descriptive, diagnostic, predictive and prescriptive analytics.

  • Collaborate with the greater Analytics Team to develop the data architecture strategy, implementation plan and customer-delivered toolset.

  • Active participation in and support of the Memorial Hermann Data Governance Program.

  • Perform regular and ad-hoc analysis to produce user-friendly data analysis, insights, reports and/or visualizations for executive and client review.

  • Continuous improvement of existing processes to identify data inconsistencies that may impact insights.

  • Summarize analytical insights, communicate and distribute insights to leadership as well as across technical teams by incorporating new techniques, initiatives and technologies.

  • Provide support from problem analysis through resolution to correct deficiencies within analytic, reporting and visualization applications.

  • Continually further analytics knowledge and skill set through various channels to ensure MHHS remains on the cutting edge of the Healthcare industry.

  • Key member of the project team responsible for training, coaching and mentoring new analytic professionals to meet the established standard.

  • Ensures safe care to patients, staff and visitors; adheres to all Memorial Hermann policies, procedures, and standards within budgetary specifications including time management, supply management, productivity and quality of service

With Sona, our voice-first AI Mental Health Specialist, Pelago now applies that same clinically-driven model to mental health, pairing deep clinical expertise with technology to expand access without compromising care quality. We believe technology should make clinical care more precise and more human, not replace the judgment behind it.

Pelago has scaled to helping hundreds of employers and health plans and has already helped more than 750,000 members better manage their substance use. If you're passionate about AI and making an impact on the health of others, join us and make it happen!

Overview of the Role:

We're hiring a Licensed Therapist (LPC or LCSW) to join the leading digital clinic for substance addictions. As a key member of our counseling team, you'll play a crucial role in supporting and empowering individuals on their journey to overcome substance addictions. Your main objective will be guiding members towards leading addiction-free lives. Collaborating closely with our dynamic team, you'll contribute to the rapid growth of our business, gaining invaluable firsthand experience in scaling a successful venture.

This is a full-time, remote position open to candidates based anywhere in the U.S., provided they hold an active LPC or LCSW license in Florida.

In this role you will:

  • Provide counseling to members on a weekly basis through text-based chat, video calls, and phone calls, to monitor their progress on their recovery journey

  • Be supportive and encouraging to members to help them establish and sustain motivation to change their substance use
  • Collaborate with other departments to ensure a positive experience for all members and provide valuable feedback to the product development team
  • Uphold good standing with your active license(s)/certification(s)

jobs.title: Vice-président de produit pur diriger LogMeIn Resolve / VP of Product Management
jobs.excerpt: Job Description Votre lieu de travail: N’importe où au Québec Chez GoTo, l’innovation portée par l’application concrète de l’IA touche toutes les sphères de notre entreprise, pas seulement nos équipes techniques.
jobs.description:
Job Description

Votre lieu de travail: N’importe où au Québec

Chez GoTo, l’innovation portée par l’application concrète de l’IA touche toutes les sphères de notre entreprise, pas seulement nos équipes techniques. Nous adoptons des outils alimentés par l’IA intuitifs et conviviaux ainsi qu’une approche créative de la résolution de problèmes, afin d’améliorer notre façon de collaborer et de servir nos clients. Ici, vous ferez partie d’une communauté collaborative qui apprend, s’adapte et inspire le changement en tout temps. Si vous aspirez à établir des relations solides et à faire une différence significative au quotidien, GoTo est le bon endroit pour vous.

À propos du poste

GoTo recherche un(e) vice-président(e) de produit pour diriger LogMeIn Resolve, notre plateforme de gestion des TI et de soutien à distance reconnue et utilisée par les équipes des TI et les prestataires de services gérés (PSG) à l’échelle mondiale. Il s’agit d’un poste à forte influence qui allie la stratégie produit à un leadership transversal pour générer des résultats commerciaux pour l’entreprise.

Resolve se trouve à un moment charnière, évoluant d’un outil d’accès à distance de premier ordre à une plateforme de gestion unifiée des appareils (UEM), caractérisée par des capacités d’IA agentique et une architecture à vérification systématique. Vous dirigerez cette transformation avec détermination en favorisant une croissance efficiente, en exerçant une grande autonomie et en représentant Resolve au niveau de la haute direction auprès de l’ensemble de GoTo.

Votre quotidien

En tant qu’un(e) Vice-président(e) de produit pur diriger LogMeIn Resolveun(e) vice-président(e) de produit pour diriger LogMeIn Resolve un(e) vice-président(e) de produit pour diriger LogMeIn Resolve un(e) vice-président(e) de produit pour diriger LogMeIn Resolve un(e) vice-président(e) de produit pour diriger LogMeIn Resolve, votre travail inclura les tâches suivantes :

  • Définir et piloter la vision du produit, la stratégie et la feuille de route pluriannuelle pour Resolve, en couvrant la gestion et la surveillance à distance (RMM), la gestion des appareils mobiles et la gestion unifiée des appareils (MDM/UEM), l’accès et le soutien à distance, le centre de services, la gestion des actifs TI (ITAM), les intégrations et le canal PSG.
  • Diriger la stratégie en matière d’IA agentique, de sorte de positionner Resolve comme une plateforme de référence dans l’automatisation des TI alimentée par l’IA.
  • Cerner les tendances émergentes et les besoins des clients afin d’orienter l’innovation et la différenciation du produit.
  • Prendre des décisions de priorisation dans un contexte de ressources limitées, en conciliant le rythme d’exécution, la dette technique et les paris stratégiques.
  • Diriger et développer une organisation de gestion des produits de plus de 15 personnes réparties dans plusieurs régions, en bâtissant une capacité d’IA agentique et en investissant dans le développement de l’équipe.
  • Collaborer avec les équipes des ventes, du marketing, de la réussite client et du développement afin de réaliser la feuille de route et de faire croître le pipeline, le taux de conversion et l’expansion dans les segments PME et PSG intermédiaires/supérieurs.
  • Assumer la responsabilité des objectifs et surveiller le rendement par rapport au plan (y compris la croissance du revenu annuel récurrent, la rétention nette du revenu et les commandes) en mettant en évidence les risques et les occasions auprès de la direction.
  • Interagir directement avec les clients et représenter Resolve lors de forums exécutifs, d’événements du secteur et auprès de partenaires importants.

Ce que nous recherchons

En tant qu’un(e) Vice-président(e) de produit pur diriger LogMeIn Resolve, vous devriez avoir un profil similaire au suivant :

  • Au minimum 10 ans d’expérience en gestion de produits, dont au moins 3 à 5 ans dans un poste de haute direction ou de vice-présidence, idéalement avec imputabilité en matière de profits et de pertes.
  • Expérience dans l’expansion d’un produit de logiciel-service B2B connaissant croissance et changement, et non simplement dans la gestion d’un produit mature.
  • Expérience en gestion des TI, en gestion des points terminaux ou dans un secteur adjacent de l’infrastructure d’entreprise (gestion et surveillance à distance, gestion unifiée des appareils, gestion des appareils mobiles, gestion des services TI).
  • Capacité démontrée à diriger des équipes interfonctionnelles vers des résultats mesurables tels que la croissance du revenu annuel récurrent, la fidélisation et le développement du pipeline.
  • Expérience en développement de produits d’IA ou agentiques, y compris en conception de systèmes agentiques.
  • Expérience dans le canal PSG, avec une compréhension des dynamiques commerciales et de produits du marché des services gérés.
  • Facilité à faire des présentations auprès de cadres et de publics internationaux; capacité de travailler efficacement entre les fuseaux horaires du Royaume-Uni/de l’Europe et de l’Amérique du Nord.

Ce que nous offrons

Chez GoTo, nous tenons à aider nos employés à réussir au travail et à se sentir soutenus dans leur vie personnelle. Nos avantages sociaux et nos programmes pour les employés sont conçus pour soutenir votre bien-être, votre croissance et votre sentiment d’appartenance. Voici ce à quoi vous pouvez vous attendre en tant que membre de notre équipe :

  • Des avantages médicaux complets;
  • Des congés et vacances payés généreux, des congés pour bénévolat, des journées de bien-être personnel trimestrielles et des journées sans réunions garanties;
  • Le remboursement des frais de scolarité et l’accès à des programmes de formation et de perfectionnement dirigés par un formateur ou accessibles à la demande;
  • Le programme de bien-être Thrive Global, un programme confidentiel d’aide aux employés (PAE), une application de bien-être et l’encadrement individuel en matière de bien-être;
  • Des communautés et programmes dirigés par les employés, y compris les groupes de ressources pour les employés (GRE), le programme « GoTo s’implique » ainsi que le jumelage des dons à des organismes de bienfaisance.

Nous fournissons de nombreux efforts à créer un milieu dans lequel chacun se sent accueilli, respecté et en mesure de contribuer. Bâtir une culture d’appartenance ne se limite pas à de belles paroles : c’est au cœur de notre façon de travailler jour après jour.

Les avantages et offres exacts peuvent varier d’un pays à l’autre, conformément à la réglementation nationale et aux pratiques du marché.

*** Langue de travail pour les postes situés au Québec

La connaissance du français est requise pour les postes situés en permanence au Québec afin que le titulaire puisse communiquer au besoin avec ses collègues, les partenaires et les fournisseurs au Québec. Une formation en français est offerte à tout titulaire d’un poste permanent au Québec qui ne possède pas une bonne connaissance du français.

*** Autres exigences linguistiques

La maîtrise de l’anglais est requise pour ce poste afin de communiquer avec les collègues, les clients et les partenaires (ou les fournisseurs) qui sont majoritairement situés à l’extérieur du Québec. Pour les postes en recherche et développement, il est également nécessaire de comprendre la documentation technique et scientifique de notre industrie disponible majoritairement en anglais.

Chez GoTo, vous trouverez la flexibilité, les ressources et le soutien dont vous avez besoin pour vous épanouir au travail, à la maison et partout ailleurs. Vous travaillerez à la réalisation d’un objectif commun avec une équipe ouverte d’esprit et unie dont l’impact est plus grand que la somme de ses parties. Nous nous engageons à créer un espace inclusif pour tous, parce que nous savons que ces perspectives uniques font de nous une entreprise et une communauté plus forte. Joignez-vous à nous pour faire partie d’une entreprise qui investit dans votre avenir. Ensemble, nous serons authentiques, nous verrons grand, nous avancerons rapidement, nous grandirons continuellement et nous maintiendrons notre priorité client. En savoir plus.

Job Description

About the Role

GoTo is looking for a VP of Product to lead LogMeIn Resolve, our IT management and remote support platform trusted by IT teams and MSPs worldwide. This is a high-impact role that combines product strategy with cross-functional leadership to drive commercial outcomes for the business.

Resolve is at a pivotal moment, evolving from a best-in-class remote access tool into a unified endpoint management (UEM) platform, distinguished by agentic AI capabilities and a zero-trust architecture. You'll lead this transformation with conviction — scaling growth efficiently, operating with significant autonomy, and representing Resolve at the executive level across GoTo.

Your Day to Day

Define and drive the multi-year product vision, strategy, and roadmap for Resolve across RMM, MDM/UEM, remote access & support, helpdesk, ITAM, integrations, and the MSP channel.
Lead the agentic AI strategy, positioning Resolve as a category-defining platform for AI-powered IT automation.
Identify emerging trends and customer needs to guide product innovation and differentiation.
Make prioritization decisions in a resource-constrained environment, balancing execution pace, technical debt, and strategic bets.
Lead and grow a 15+ person product management organization across multiple geographies, building agentic AI capability and investing in team development.
Partner with Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, and Engineering to deliver the roadmap and grow pipeline, win rates, and expansion in the mid-upper SMB and MSP segments.
Own targets and track performance against plan — including ARR growth, net revenue retention, and bookings — surfacing risks and opportunities to leadership.
Engage directly with customers and represent Resolve in executive forums, at industry events, and with key partners.

What We're Looking For

10+ years of product management experience, including 3–5+ years in a senior director- or VP-level role, ideally with P&L accountability.
Experience scaling a B2B SaaS product through growth and change — not just managing a mature product.
Background in IT management, endpoint management, or an adjacent enterprise infrastructure category (RMM, UEM, MDM, ITSM).
Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional teams toward measurable outcomes such as ARR growth, retention, and pipeline.
Experience with AI/agentic product development, including agentic system design.
MSP channel experience, with an understanding of the commercial and product dynamics of the managed services market.
Comfortable presenting to executive and international audiences; able to work effectively across UK/European and North American time zones.

jobs.description:
Sobre a área:

No Grupo RBS, conectamos marcas, pessoas e comunidades por meio de um ecossistema de comunicação que integra mídia, conteúdo, eventos e soluções digitais. A Squad B2C é responsável por desenvolver e evoluir a plataforma de assinatura que sustenta a jornada de aquisição, autenticação e gestão de assinaturas digitais, garantindo soluções escaláveis, seguras e de alta performance.

Esta é uma oportunidade para profissionais que se identificam com o desenvolvimento backend, gostam de construir soluções escaláveis e de alta disponibilidade e buscam atuar em um ambiente colaborativo, participando da evolução de produtos digitais que impactam milhares de usuários.

Aqui, valorizamos pessoas protagonistas, colaborativas, curiosas e orientadas para resultados, que queiram crescer em um ambiente dinâmico, inovador e com forte conexão com o mercado.

Como será seu dia a dia:

  • Desenvolver e manter APIs e serviços backend em Java e Python, garantindo performance e escalabilidade para os fluxos de aquisição e checkout de assinaturas digitais;
  • Desenvolver integrações de sistemas internos e externos, incluindo gateways de pagamento e provedores de autenticação, garantindo a comunicação e o funcionamento correto entre serviços e aplicações;
  • Implementar testes automatizados e revisão de código para garantir qualidade;
  • Colaborar com frontend, QA e produto em entregas consistentes e escaláveis;
  • Aplicar boas práticas de versionamento, documentação e pipelines de CI/CD;
  • Apoiar desenvolvedores Júnior no dia a dia, compartilhando boas práticas de desenvolvimento;
  • Contribuir com sugestões de melhoria na arquitetura de microsserviços e nas soluções de backend, com foco em performance e conversão no funil de checkout.

O que o Grupo RBS espera de você:

  • Graduação completa em Ciência da Computação, Análise e Desenvolvimento de Sistemas ou cursos afins;
  • Experiência sólida em programação com Java (Spring Boot) e/ou Python (Flask);
  • Experiência com APIs REST e integração com serviços externos (ex: gateways de pagamento, provedores de autenticação);
  • Experiência prática no uso de microsserviços, incluindo deploy e integração de eventos;
  • Experiência prática no uso de ferramentas de build (Maven, Gradle) e/ou empacotamento Python (pip, Poetry, virtualenv);
  • Experiência sólida no uso de Git e versionamento de código;
  • Experiência no uso de bancos de dados relacionais e não relacionais, incluindo modelagem e otimização de queries;
  • Conhecimento em computação em nuvem (preferencialmente GCP);
  • Conhecimento sobre o uso de Docker;
  • Experiência com cache e mensageria: Redis (cache e Streams/PubSub), RabbitMQ, Kafka ou Google Cloud Pub/Sub, incluindo padrões publish/subscribe e processamento assíncrono.

Será um diferencial se tiver:

  • Experiência com containers e orquestração (Docker, Kubernetes);
  • Vivência com CDN, balanceamento de carga e caching;
  • Experiência com integração com sistemas financeiros/gateways de pagamento e/ou APIs bancárias.

Do you have a passion for engaging with people and helping them on their journey to better health? Signify Health, part of CVS Health®, is seeking a Full Time Clinician (Nurse Practitioner or Physician Assistant) to provide In-Home Health Evaluations, engaging with people in the comfort of their own homes and helping bridge gaps in care.

You’ll play a critical role in building trusted relationships to make people healthier, helping bring flexible, comprehensive and personalized health evaluations right to people’s front doors.

Job highlights

The visit, which lasts about 45 minutes, allows for time to connect one-on-one and answer health questions. It includes a medication and medical history review, a physical evaluation, and, if ordered by the person’s health plan, additional diagnostic tests (i.e., diabetic eye exams, spirometry, etc.). You’ll use an iPad and an intuitive clinical workflow for each evaluation and are not required to prescribe medicine, order lab tests or alter people’s current treatment regimen.

In this role, you will:

  • Bring your heart into every visit, joining a national network of purpose-driven clinicians dedicated to improving health outcomes

  • Conduct virtual visits as needed

  • Provide all Signify Health services as indicated including Diagnostic & Preventive Services products (i.e., spirometry, DEE, bone density screening, etc.)

​

As an in-home clinician, your primary workplace is the private residence of health plan members. We are dedicated to meeting health plan members where they are, wherever they call home. Candidates must be able to comfortably and safely perform their duties in homes that may contain household pets, secondhand smoke and other potential airborne allergens or irritants.

“I love seeing health plan members at home. You get a better picture of their health when you see where they live.” - Erica R., PA

I have the time to provide education so people have a better understanding of their health. I can answer their questions without rushing out the door.” - Andrew K., PA

About Zscaler

Zscaler accelerates digital transformation to ensure our customers can be more agile, efficient, resilient, and secure. As an AI-forward enterprise, we are constantly pushing the envelope, leveraging the world’s largest security data lake to power our cloud-native Zero Trust Exchange platform. This innovation protects our customers from cyberattacks and data loss by securely connecting users, devices, and applications in any location.

Here, impact in your role matters more than title and trust is built on results. We say, impact over activity. We seek innovators who actively use AI to amplify their impact and who thrive in an environment where we leverage intelligent systems to stay ahead of evolving threats. We believe in transparency and value constructive, honest debate—we’re focused on getting to the best ideas, faster. We build high-performing teams that can make an impact quickly and with high quality. To do this, we are building a culture of execution centered on customer obsession, collaboration, ownership, and accountability.

We value high-impact, high-accountability with a sense of urgency where you’re enabled to do your best work and embrace your potential. If you’re driven by purpose, thrive on solving complex challenges, and want to be part of the team that’s helping to secure the AI age, we invite you to bring your talents to Zscaler and help shape the future of cybersecurity.

We are looking for a Senior Specialist Sales Engineer to join our team. This is a remote based in the UK role, reporting to the Specialist Solution Director in the Zero Trust Cloud team department. The Senior Specialist Sales Engineer serves as the primary technical lead and strategic advisor, guiding customers across the UK to secure workloads and traffic across diverse hybrid and multi-cloud environments by leveraging Zscaler’s Zero Trust Architecture to achieve key business outcomes. The role will also collaborate with field teams at the highest levels, driving internal and customer-facing enablement for Zero Trust Cloud use cases to accelerate Zscaler’s regional GTM strategy while acting as a critical link between the field and Product Management to influence the Product Roadmap.

What you’ll do (Role Expectations)

  • Serve as the technical expert for Zero Trust Architecture in Cloud environments, focusing on AWS, Azure, and GCP
  • Collaborate with sales and engineering teams to provide technical insights that influence the Product roadmap
  • Lead conversations about Zero Trust Security trends, strategies, and deployment with customers at all organizational levels
  • Run customer Proof-of-Value engagements in collaboration with Sales Engineers, demonstrating Zscaler’s unique value proposition

About the Role

As a Product Owner at Plume, you will serve as the tactical engine who translates strategic vision into well-executed software features that directly improve the healthcare experience for trans lives.

Every day, you will refine the backlog, guide cross-functional teams through execution, and serve as an empathetic, high-EQ connector who navigates delivery friction and team dynamics with composure. You will feel most confident in high-velocity, collaborative environments where you prioritize getting it right over being right to ensure seamless execution.

  • A collaborative mindset focused on getting it right, not being right. Demonstrated ability to communicate effectively, build trust, and manage challenges with equanimity.

  • Proven ability to write clear, user-facing release notes and comprehensive how-to guides to support feature launches and drive internal/external adoption.

  • Demonstrated experience working with 3rd-party API integrations and a strong technical understanding of backend vs. frontend concepts (hands-on coding or HTML/CSS writing is not required).

  • Proficient with Jira, Confluence, G Suite, Google Data Studio.

  • Strong verbal and written skills, with the ability to articulate technical details clearly to non-technical stakeholders.

  • High precision in writing user stories, testing edge cases, and ensuring requirements are unambiguous for engineering teams.
